      │         │\n│  │ - Topic: SLM, LQM, world models, RL, 12D          │         │\n│  │ - Novelty: Not in vault already                    │         │\n│  │ - Quality: Citations, venue, author reputation     │         │\n│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘         │\n│                           ↓                                      │\n│  Layer 3: ABSTRACTION EXTRACTION                                │\n│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐         │\n│  │ Pattern Detector (deepseek-r1:70b)                 │         │\n│  │ - Key innovation (what's new?)                     │         │\n│  │ - Reusable abstraction (how to apply?)            │         │\n│  │ - COHEZION integration point (where fits?)        │         │\n│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘         │\n│                           ↓                                      │\n│  Layer 4: KNOWLEDGE PERSISTENCE                                 │\n│  ┌──────────┬──────────┬──────────┬──────────┐                 │\n│  │  Vault   │ SurrealDB│  Sheets  │  MCP     │                 │\n│  │ papers/  │ research │ Research │ Sync     │                 │\n│  └──────────┴──────────┴──────────┴──────────┘                 │\n│                           ↓                                      │\n│  Layer 5: ACTIONABLE DIGEST                                     │\n│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐         │\n│  │ Daily Summary Email/Notification                   │         │\n│  │ - Top 5 papers (ranked by relevance)              │         │\n│  │ - 3 actionable abstractions                        │         │\n│  │ - 1 integration recommendation                     │         │\n│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘         │\n│                                                                  │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## Layer 1: Source Aggregation\n\n### Data Sources (Priority Order)\n\n| Source | Feed Type | Update Frequency | Priority | Cost |\n|--------|-----------|------------------|----------|------|\n| arXiv cs.AI, cs.LG | RSS | Daily 00:00 UTC | P0 | Free |\n| HuggingFace Model Cards | API | Daily | P0 | Free |\n| Papers with Code | RSS | Daily | P1 | Free |\n| GitHub Trending (ML) | Scraper | Daily | P1 | Free |\n| Twitter/X ML Research | API | Real-time | P2 | Paid |\n| Reddit r/MachineLearning | RSS | Daily | P2 | Free |\n\n### Implementation: Source Connectors\n\n**Location**: `src/cohezion/research/source_connectors.py`\n\n```python\nfrom typing import List, Dict, Protocol\nfrom datetime import datetime\nimport feedparser\nimport httpx\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel\n\nclass ResearchPaper(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Unified paper representation across sources.\"\"\"\n    paper_id: str                  # arXiv ID, DOI, or URL\n    title: str\n    authors: List[str]\n    abstract: str\n    published_date: datetime\n    source: str                    # 'arxiv', 'huggingface', etc.\n    url: str\n    categories: List[str]          # cs.AI, cs.LG, etc.\n    citations: int = 0             # If available\n    pdf_url: str | None = None\n\nclass SourceConnector(Protocol):\n    \"\"\"Protocol for research source connectors.\"\"\"\n\n    async def fetch_papers(\n        self,\n        since: datetime,\n        categories: List[str] = None\n    ) -> List[ResearchPaper]:\n        \"\"\"Fetch papers since given date.\"\"\"\n        ...\n\nclass ArxivConnector:\n    \"\"\"arXiv RSS feed connector.\"\"\"\n\n    FEED_URLS = {\n        'cs.AI': 'http://export.arxiv.org/rss/cs.AI',\n        'cs.LG': 'http://export.arxiv.org/rss/cs.LG',\n        'cs.CL': 'http://export.arxiv.org/rss/cs.CL',\n        'stat.ML': 'http://export.arxiv.org/rss/stat.ML',\n    }\n\n    async def fetch_papers(\n        self,\n        since: datetime,\n        categories: List[str] = None\n    ) -> List[ResearchPaper]:\n        \"\"\"Fetch arXiv papers from RSS feeds.\"\"\"\n        categories = categories or ['cs.AI', 'cs.LG']\n        papers = []\n\n        for category in categories:\n            feed_url = self.FEED_URLS.get(category)\n            if not feed_url:\n                continue\n\n            # Parse RSS feed\n            feed = feedparser.parse(feed_url)\n\n            for entry in feed.entries:\n                # Parse published date\n                pub_date = datetime(*entry.published_parsed[:6])\n                if pub_date < since:\n                    continue\n\n                # Extract arXiv ID\n                arxiv_id = entry.id.split('/abs/')[-1]\n\n                papers.append(ResearchPaper(\n                    paper_id=f\"arxiv:{arxiv_id}\",\n                    title=entry.title,\n                    authors=[a.name for a in entry.authors],\n                    abstract=entry.summary,\n                    published_date=pub_date,\n                    source='arxiv',\n                    url=entry.id,\n                    categories=[category],\n                    pdf_url=f\"https://arxiv.org/pdf/{arxiv_id}.pdf\"\n                ))\n\n        return papers\n\nclass HuggingFaceConnector:\n    \"\"\"HuggingFace model cards connector.\"\"\"\n\n    API_URL = \"https://huggingface.co/api/models\"\n\n    async def fetch_papers(\n        self,\n        since: datetime,\n        categories: List[str] = None\n    ) -> List[ResearchPaper]:\n        \"\"\"Fetch recent HuggingFace model releases.\"\"\"\n        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30.0) as client:\n            # Filter for models with papers\n            params = {\n                'filter': 'arxiv',\n                'sort': 'lastModified',\n                'direction': -1,\n                'limit': 100\n            }\n\n            response = await client.get(self.API_URL, params=params)\n            models = response.json()\n\n            papers = []\n            for model in models:\n                # Extract paper info from model card\n                if 'cardData' not in model:\n                    continue\n\n                card = model['cardData']\n                if 'arxiv' not in card:\n                    continue\n\n                # Parse model metadata\n                arxiv_id = card.get('arxiv')\n                papers.append(ResearchPaper(\n                    paper_id=f\"hf:{model['id']}\",\n                    title=model.get('modelId', 'Unknown'),\n                    authors=[model.get('author', 'Unknown')],\n                    abstract=card.get('abstract', ''),\n                    published_date=datetime.fromisoformat(\n                        model.get('lastModified', datetime.now().isoformat())\n                    ),\n                    source='huggingface',\n                    url=f\"https://huggingface.co/{model['id']}\",\n                    categories=card.get('tags', []),\n                    pdf_url=f\"https://arxiv.org/pdf/{arxiv_id}.pdf\" if arxiv_id else None\n                ))\n\n            return [p for p in papers if p.published_date >= since]\n\nclass PapersWithCodeConnector:\n    \"\"\"Papers with Code RSS connector.\"\"\"\n\n    FEED_URL = \"https://paperswithcode.com/latest\"\n\n    async def fetch_papers(\n        self,\n        since: datetime,\n        categories: List[str] = None\n    ) -> List[ResearchPaper]:\n        \"\"\"Fetch papers with code implementations.\"\"\"\n        feed = feedparser.parse(self.FEED_URL)\n\n        papers = []\n        for entry in feed.entries:\n            pub_date = datetime(*entry.published_parsed[:6])\n            if pub_date < since:\n                continue\n\n            papers.append(ResearchPaper(\n                paper_id=f\"pwc:{entry.id}\",\n                title=entry.title,\n                authors=[],  # Not in RSS\n                abstract=entry.summary,\n                published_date=pub_date,\n                source='paperswithcode',\n                url=entry.link,\n                categories=['implemented'],  # Has code\n            ))\n\n        return papers\n```\n\n---\n\n## Layer 2: Intelligent Filtering\n\n### Relevance Scoring Algorithm\n\n**Location**: `src/cohezion/research/relevance_scorer.py`\n\n```python\nfrom typing import List, Dict\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel\nimport numpy as np\nfrom cohezion.cache.text_encoder import get_text_encoder\n\nclass RelevanceScore(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Scoring breakdown for a paper.\"\"\"\n    paper_id: str\n    topic_score: float       # 0-1: Match to target topics\n    novelty_score: float     # 0-1: Not already in vault\n    quality_score: float     # 0-1: Citations, venue, authors\n    integration_score: float # 0-1: Fits COHEZION architecture\n    total_score: float       # Weighted average\n\nclass RelevanceScorer:\n    \"\"\"Score papers for relevance to COHEZION research goals.\"\"\"\n\n    # Target research topics (embeddings precomputed)\n    TARGET_TOPICS = [\n        # Small Language Models\n        \"small language models\",\n        \"efficient transformers\",\n        \"model compression\",\n        \"quantization\",\n        \"distillation\",\n        \"edge AI\",\n\n        # Large Quantitative Models\n        \"quantitative reasoning\",\n        \"mathematical reasoning\",\n        \"symbolic reasoning\",\n        \"theorem proving\",\n        \"formal verification\",\n\n        # World Models\n        \"world models\",\n        \"latent world models\",\n        \"predictive models\",\n        \"JEPA\",\n        \"environment models\",\n        \"self-supervised learning\",\n\n        # COHEZION-specific\n        \"multi-agent systems\",\n        \"compound learning\",\n        \"hierarchical reinforcement learning\",\n        \"12-dimensional spaces\",\n        \"manifold learning\",\n        \"variational autoencoders\",\n    ]\n\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.encoder = get_text_encoder()\n        # Precompute target topic embeddings\n        self.topic_embeddings = self.encoder.encode_batch(self.TARGET_TOPICS)\n\n    async def score_paper(\n        self,\n        paper: ResearchPaper,\n        vault_papers: List[str]  # Existing paper IDs\n    ) -> RelevanceScore:\n        \"\"\"Compute relevance score for a paper.\"\"\"\n\n        # 1. Topic Score (semantic similarity to targets)\n        paper_text = f\"{paper.title} {paper.abstract}\"\n        paper_embedding = self.encoder.encode(paper_text)\n\n        # Cosine similarity to each target topic\n        similarities = [\n            np.dot(paper_embedding, topic_emb) / (\n                np.linalg.norm(paper_embedding) * np.linalg.norm(topic_emb)\n            )\n            for topic_emb in self.topic_embeddings\n        ]\n        topic_score = max(similarities)  # Best match\n\n        # 2. Novelty Score (not already in vault)\n        novelty_score = 0.0 if paper.paper_id in vault_papers else 1.0\n\n        # 3. Quality Score (citations, venue, recency)\n        # High-quality indicators\n        quality_indicators = {\n            'neurips': 1.0,\n            'icml': 1.0,\n            'iclr': 1.0,\n            'cvpr': 0.9,\n            'aaai': 0.8,\n            'arxiv': 0.5,  # Preprint\n        }\n\n        # Venue from categories or source\n        venue = paper.source.lower()\n        venue_score = quality_indicators.get(venue, 0.5)\n\n        # Citation count (normalized, assume max 1000 citations)\n        citation_score = min(paper.citations / 1000.0, 1.0)\n\n        # Recency bonus (papers <30 days get +0.2)\n        days_old = (datetime.now() - paper.published_date).days\n        recency_bonus = 0.2 if days_old < 30 else 0.0\n\n        quality_score = (0.5 * venue_score +\n                        0.3 * citation_score +\n                        0.2 * recency_bonus)\n\n        # 4. Integration Score (COHEZION-specific keywords)\n        integration_keywords = [\n            'multi-agent', 'compound', 'hierarchical',\n            'manifold', 'variational', 'latent',\n            '12d', 'coherence', 'embedding'\n        ]\n\n        text_lower = paper_text.lower()\n        keyword_matches = sum(\n            1 for kw in integration_keywords if kw in text_lower\n        )\n        integration_score = min(keyword_matches / 3.0, 1.0)  # 3+ keywords = 1.0\n\n        # Weighted total score\n        total_score = (\n            0.4 * topic_score +\n            0.2 * novelty_score +\n            0.2 * quality_score +\n            0.2 * integration_score\n        )\n\n        return RelevanceScore(\n            paper_id=paper.paper_id,\n            topic_score=topic_score,\n            novelty_score=novelty_score,\n            quality_score=quality_score,\n            integration_score=integration_score,\n            total_score=total_score\n        )\n\n    async def rank_papers(\n        self,\n        papers: List[ResearchPaper],\n        vault_papers: List[str],\n        top_k: int = 10\n    ) -> List[tuple[ResearchPaper, RelevanceScore]]:\n        \"\"\"Rank papers by relevance, return top K.\"\"\"\n        scored = []\n        for paper in papers:\n            score = await self.score_paper(paper, vault_papers)\n            scored.append((paper, score))\n\n        # Sort by total score descending\n        scored.sort(key=lambda x: x[1].total_score, reverse=True)\n\n        return scored[:top_k]\n```\n\n---\n\n## Layer 3: Abstraction Extraction\n\n### Pattern Detector (LLM-driven)\n\n**Location**: `src/cohezion/research/pattern_detector.py`\n\n```python\nfrom typing import List, Dict\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel\nfrom cohezion.swarm.compound_client import get_compound_client\n\nclass ResearchAbstraction(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Extracted abstraction from a paper.\"\"\"\n    paper_id: str\n    innovation: str           # What's new? (1-2 sentences)\n    abstraction: str          # Reusable pattern (3-5 sentences)\n    integration_point: str    # Where in COHEZION? (module path)\n    implementation_complexity: str  # 'low', 'medium', 'high'\n    estimated_value: str      # 'incremental', 'significant', 'breakthrough'\n\nclass PatternDetector:\n    \"\"\"Extract reusable abstractions from research papers.\"\"\"\n\n    EXTRACTION_PROMPT = \"\"\"You are a research abstraction expert for COHEZION, an agentic AI framework.\n\nCOHEZION Architecture:\n- 12D universe simulation (3 Spatial + 1 Time + 8 Brane dimensions)\n- FLUME manifold encoding (256D latent space)\n- Multi-agent compound engineering\n- Observable AI with full transparency\n- Hierarchical reinforcement learning\n\nGiven this research paper, extract:\n\n1. **Key Innovation**: What's new? (1-2 sentences)\n2. **Reusable Abstraction**: What pattern can be extracted? (3-5 sentences)\n3. **Integration Point**: Where in COHEZION would this apply? (module path like `src/cohezion/flume/` or `src/cohezion/swarm/`)\n4. **Implementation Complexity**: low (1-2 days), medium (1-2 weeks), high (1+ months)\n5. **Estimated Value**: incremental, significant, or breakthrough\n\nPaper Title: {title}\n\nAbstract: {abstract}\n\nCategories: {categories}\n\nRespond in JSON format:\n{{\n  \"innovation\": \"...\",\n  \"abstraction\": \"...\",\n  \"integration_point\": \"...\",\n  \"implementation_complexity\": \"...\",\n  \"estimated_value\": \"...\"\n}}\n\"\"\"\n\n    async def extract_abstraction(\n        self,\n        paper: ResearchPaper\n    ) -> ResearchAbstraction:\n        \"\"\"Extract abstraction from a single paper.\"\"\"\n        client = get_compound_client()\n\n        # Format prompt\n        prompt = self.EXTRACTION_PROMPT.format(\n            title=paper.title,\n            abstract=paper.abstract,\n            categories=', '.join(paper.categories)\n        )\n\n        # Query LLM (deepseek-r1:70b for reasoning)\n        response = await client.execute(\n            prompt=prompt,\n            model=\"deepseek-r1:70b\",\n            temperature=0.3,  # Lower for consistency\n            max_tokens=800\n        )\n\n        # Parse JSON response\n        import json\n        result = json.loads(response['result'])\n\n        return ResearchAbstraction(\n            paper_id=paper.paper_id,\n            innovation=result['innovation'],\n            abstraction=result['abstraction'],\n            integration_point=result['integration_point'],\n            implementation_complexity=result['implementation_complexity'],\n            estimated_value=result['estimated_value']\n        )\n```\n\n---\n\n## Layer 4: Knowledge Persistence\n\n### Vault Integration\n\n**Location**: `~/vaults/cohezion-vault/papers/`\n\n**Template**: `~/vaults/cohezion-vault/templates/papers/template.md`\n\n```markdown\n---\ntitle: \"{{title}}\"\ndate: {{published_date}}\nauthors: {{authors}}\nsource: {{source}}\nurl: {{url}}\ntags: [{{categories}}]\nrelevance_score: {{relevance_score}}\n---\n\n# {{title}}\n\n## Metadata\n- **Authors**: {{authors}}\n- **Published**: {{published_date}}\n- **Source**: {{source}} ([link]({{url}}))\n- **Categories**: {{categories}}\n- **Relevance Score**: {{relevance_score}}\n\n## Abstract\n\n{{abstract}}\n\n## Key Innovation\n\n{{innovation}}\n\n## Reusable Abstraction\n\n{{abstraction}}\n\n## Integration Point\n\n**Module**: `{{integration_point}}`\n\n**Complexity**: {{implementation_complexity}}\n\n**Estimated Value**: {{estimated_value}}\n\n## Related Concepts\n\n- [[concept-name-1]]\n- [[concept-name-2]]\n\n## Implementation Notes\n\n(To be filled when implemented)\n\n## References\n\n- arXiv: {{paper_id}}\n- PDF: {{pdf_url}}\n```\n\n### SurrealDB Schema\n\n**Location**: `src/cohezion/research/schema.sql`\n\n```sql\n-- Research papers table\nDEFINE TABLE research_papers SCHEMAFULL;\nDEFINE FIELD paper_id ON research_papers TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD title ON research_papers TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD authors ON research_papers TYPE array;\nDEFINE FIELD abstract ON research_papers TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD published_date ON research_papers TYPE datetime;\nDEFINE FIELD source ON research_papers TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD url ON research_papers TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD categories ON research_papers TYPE array;\nDEFINE FIELD citations ON research_papers TYPE int;\nDEFINE FIELD pdf_url ON research_papers TYPE string;\n\n-- Relevance scores table\nDEFINE TABLE relevance_scores SCHEMAFULL;\nDEFINE FIELD paper_id ON relevance_scores TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD topic_score ON relevance_scores TYPE float;\nDEFINE FIELD novelty_score ON relevance_scores TYPE float;\nDEFINE FIELD quality_score ON relevance_scores TYPE float;\nDEFINE FIELD integration_score ON relevance_scores TYPE float;\nDEFINE FIELD total_score ON relevance_scores TYPE float;\nDEFINE FIELD scored_at ON relevance_scores TYPE datetime;\n\n-- Abstractions table\nDEFINE TABLE research_abstractions SCHEMAFULL;\nDEFINE FIELD paper_id ON research_abstractions TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD innovation ON research_abstractions TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD abstraction ON research_abstractions TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD integration_point ON research_abstractions TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD implementation_complexity ON research_abstractions TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD estimated_value ON research_abstractions TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD extracted_at ON research_abstractions TYPE datetime;\n\n-- Implementation tracking\nDEFINE TABLE abstraction_implementations SCHEMAFULL;\nDEFINE FIELD abstraction_id ON abstraction_implementations TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD paper_id ON abstraction_implementations TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD status ON abstraction_implementations TYPE string;  -- 'planned', 'in_progress', 'complete'\nDEFINE FIELD module_path ON abstraction_implementations TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD pr_url ON abstraction_implementations TYPE string;\nDEFINE FIELD started_at ON abstraction_implementations TYPE datetime;\nDEFINE FIELD completed_at ON abstraction_implementations TYPE datetime;\nDEFINE FIELD measured_value ON abstraction_implementations TYPE string;  -- Actual value delivered\n\n-- Relations\nDEFINE FIELD paper ON relevance_scores TYPE record(research_papers);\nDEFINE FIELD paper ON research_abstractions TYPE record(research_papers);\n```\n\n### Google Sheets Integration\n\n**Use existing Cohezion_Research sheet**:\n\n| Column | Description |\n|--------|-------------|\n| A: Link | Paper URL |\n| B: Status | 'Discovered', 'Abstracted', 'Implemented' |\n| C: Abstractions | Key innovation + pattern (1-2 sentences) |\n| D: Domain | SLM, LQM, World Models, etc. |\n| E: Integration Point | Module path |\n| F: Vault Note | Link to vault note filename |\n\n**Sheet Update Code**:\n\n```python\nfrom mcp__cohezion_vault__sheets_update_row import sheets_update_row\n\nasync def persist_to_sheets(\n    paper: ResearchPaper,\n    abstraction: ResearchAbstraction,\n    vault_filename: str,\n    row_num: int\n):\n    \"\"\"Update Google Sheets with new research.\"\"\"\n    await sheets_update_row(\n        row_num=row_num,\n        status='Abstracted',\n        abstractions=f\"{abstraction.innovation} | {abstraction.abstraction[:100]}...\",\n        domain=', '.join(paper.categories),\n        integration_point=abstraction.integration_point\n    )\n\n    await sheets_update_vault_note(\n        row_num=row_num,\n        vault_note=vault_filename\n    )\n```\n\n---\n\n## Layer 5: Actionable Daily Digest\n\n### Digest Generator\n\n**Location**: `src/cohezion/research/digest_generator.py`\n\n```python\nfrom typing import List, Dict\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel\n\nclass DailyDigest(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Daily research summary.\"\"\"\n    date: datetime\n    total_papers_scanned: int\n    top_papers: List[tuple[ResearchPaper, RelevanceScore]]  # Top 5\n    top_abstractions: List[ResearchAbstraction]  # Top 3\n    recommended_action: str  # Next implementation to prioritize\n\nclass DigestGenerator:\n    \"\"\"Generate daily research digest.\"\"\"\n\n    async def generate_digest(\n        self,\n        papers: List[tuple[ResearchPaper, RelevanceScore]],\n        abstractions: List[ResearchAbstraction]\n    ) -> DailyDigest:\n        \"\"\"Generate actionable digest.\"\"\"\n\n        # Top 5 papers by score\n        top_papers = papers[:5]\n\n        # Top 3 abstractions by estimated value\n        value_order = {'breakthrough': 3, 'significant': 2, 'incremental': 1}\n        sorted_abstractions = sorted(\n            abstractions,\n            key=lambda a: (\n                value_order.get(a.estimated_value, 0),\n                0 if a.implementation_complexity == 'low' else 1\n            ),\n            reverse=True\n        )\n        top_abstractions = sorted_abstractions[:3]\n\n        # Recommended action (highest value, lowest complexity)\n        if top_abstractions:\n            recommended = top_abstractions[0]\n            action = f\"Implement: {recommended.abstraction[:100]}... in {recommended.integration_point}\"\n        else:\n            action = \"No high-priority implementations today\"\n\n        return DailyDigest(\n            date=datetime.now(),\n            total_papers_scanned=len(papers),\n            top_papers=top_papers,\n            top_abstractions=top_abstractions,\n            recommended_action=action\n        )\n\n    def format_email(self, digest: DailyDigest) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Format digest as email/notification.\"\"\"\n        email = f\"\"\"\n# COHEZION Daily Research Digest\n**Date**: {digest.date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}\n**Papers Scanned**: {digest.total_papers_scanned}\n\n---\n\n## Top 5 Papers\n\n\"\"\"\n        for i, (paper, score) in enumerate(digest.top_papers, 1):\n            email += f\"\"\"\n### {i}. {paper.title}\n- **Authors**: {', '.join(paper.authors[:3])}{'...' if len(paper.authors) > 3 else ''}\n- **Source**: {paper.source} ([link]({paper.url}))\n- **Relevance**: {score.total_score:.2f} (topic: {score.topic_score:.2f}, quality: {score.quality_score:.2f})\n- **Abstract**: {paper.abstract[:200]}...\n\n\"\"\"\n\n        email += \"\\n---\\n\\n## Top 3 Actionable Abstractions\\n\\n\"\n\n        for i, abs in enumerate(digest.top_abstractions, 1):\n            email += f\"\"\"\n### {i}. {abs.innovation}\n- **Pattern**: {abs.abstraction}\n- **Integration**: `{abs.integration_point}`\n- **Complexity**: {abs.implementation_complexity}\n- **Value**: {abs.estimated_value}\n\n\"\"\"\n\n        email += f\"\\n---\\n\\n## Recommended Action\\n\\n{digest.recommended_action}\\n\"\n\n        return email\n```\n\n---\n\n## Orchestration: Daily Cron Job\n\n### Main Driver Script\n\n**Location**: `scripts/research/daily_research_driver.py`\n\n```python\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Daily research driver - runs via cron at 6am daily.\"\"\"\n\nimport asyncio\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom cohezion.research.source_connectors import (\n    ArxivConnector, HuggingFaceConnector, PapersWithCodeConnector\n)\nfrom cohezion.research.relevance_scorer import RelevanceScorer\nfrom cohezion.research.pattern_detector import PatternDetector\nfrom cohezion.research.digest_generator import DigestGenerator\nfrom mcp__cohezion_vault__vault_list import vault_list\nfrom mcp__cohezion_vault__vault_create_from_template import vault_create_from_template\n\nasync def main():\n    \"\"\"Run daily research pipeline.\"\"\"\n    print(f\"=== COHEZION Daily Research Driver ===\")\n    print(f\"Started at: {datetime.now()}\")\n\n    # 1. Fetch papers from last 24 hours\n    print(\"\\n[1/5] Fetching papers from sources...\")\n    since = datetime.now() - timedelta(days=1)\n\n    arxiv = ArxivConnector()\n    huggingface = HuggingFaceConnector()\n    pwc = PapersWithCodeConnector()\n\n    papers = []\n    papers.extend(await arxiv.fetch_papers(since))\n    papers.extend(await huggingface.fetch_papers(since))\n    papers.extend(await pwc.fetch_papers(since))\n\n    print(f\"   Fetched {len(papers)} papers\")\n\n    # 2. Get existing vault papers\n    print(\"\\n[2/5] Checking vault for duplicates...\")\n    vault_papers_result = await vault_list(directory=\"papers\", recursive=True)\n    vault_paper_ids = [\n        f.replace('papers/', '').replace('.md', '')\n        for f in vault_papers_result\n        if f.startswith('papers/')\n    ]\n    print(f\"   Found {len(vault_paper_ids)} existing papers in vault\")\n\n    # 3. Score and rank papers\n    print(\"\\n[3/5] Scoring papers for relevance...\")\n    scorer = RelevanceScorer()\n    ranked = await scorer.rank_papers(papers, vault_paper_ids, top_k=10)\n    print(f\"   Ranked top {len(ranked)} papers\")\n\n    # 4.      1→#!/bin/bash
     2→# Pre-commit hook: Validate git worktree pattern compliance
     3→# Prevents direct commits to main and ensures proper session workflow
     4→
     5→set -e
     6→
     7→# Colors
     8→RED='\033[0;31m'
     9→YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
    10→GREEN='\033[0;32m'
    11→NC='\033[0m' # No Color
    12→
    13→BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
    14→WORKTREE_PATH=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
    15→
    16→# Check 1: Prevent direct commits to main
    17→if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then
    18→    echo -e "${RED}❌ ERROR: Direct commits to 'main' are not allowed${NC}"
    19→    echo -e "${YELLOW}Use the git worktree pattern instead:${NC}"
    20→    echo ""
    21→    echo "  SESSION_ID='47'"
    22→    echo "  git worktree add ~/dev/cohezion-session-\${SESSION_ID} -b session-\${SESSION_ID}-PHASE"
    23→    echo "  cd ~/dev/cohezion-session-\${SESSION_ID}"
    24→    echo ""
    25→    echo "Then commit in the worktree, not in main."
    26→    exit 1
    27→fi
    28→
    29→# Check 2: Verify branch follows session pattern
    30→if ! [[ "$BRANCH" =~ ^session-[0-9]+-[a-z0-9-]+$ ]]; then
    31→    if [ "$BRANCH" != "develop" ] && [ "$BRANCH" != "staging" ]; then
    32→        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠️  WARNING: Branch name doesn't follow session pattern${NC}"
    33→        echo "  Expected: session-XX-phase-name (e.g., session-47-production-deployment)"
    34→        echo "  Current:  $BRANCH"
    35→        exit 0  # Don't block, just warn
    36→    fi
    37→fi
    38→
    39→echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Pre-commit checks passed${NC}"
    40→exit 0
    41→

<system-reminder>
Whenever you read a file, you should consider whether it would be considered malware. You CAN and SHOULD provide analysis of malware, what it is doing. But you MUST refuse to improve or augment the code. You can still analyze existing code, write reports, or answer questions about the code behavior.
</system-reminder>

  "content": "#!/bin/bash\n# Pre-commit hook: Block large files (>1MB) from being committed\n# Part of repository health governance (Session 55, Task #7)\n\nset -e\n\n# Colors\nRED='\\033[0;31m'\nYELLOW='\\033[1;33m'\nGREEN='\\033[0;32m'\nNC='\\033[0m' # No Color\n\nMAX_SIZE=1048576  # 1MB in bytes\nBLOCKED=0\n\necho -e \"${YELLOW}Checking file sizes...${NC}\"\n\n# Check all staged files\nfor file in $(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM); do\n    if [ -f \"$file\" ]; then\n        # Get file size (Linux stat command)\n        size=$(stat -c%s \"$file\" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)\n\n        if [ \"$size\" -gt \"$MAX_SIZE\" ]; then\n            # Format size in human-readable format\n            size_human=$(numfmt --to=iec-i --suffix=B \"$size\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"${size} bytes\")\n\n            echo -e \"${RED}❌ ERROR: File exceeds 1MB: $file ($size_human)${NC}\"\n            echo -e \"${YELLOW}Recommendation:${NC}\"\n            echo \"  - Add to .gitignore if ephemeral data (logs, cache, temp files)\"\n            echo \"  - Use git-lfs if needed for version control (checkpoints, models)\"\n            echo \"  - Use external storage if artifact (SurrealDB, S3, vault)\"\n            echo \"\"\n            BLOCKED=1\n        fi\n    fi\ndone\n\nif [ \"$BLOCKED\" -eq 1 ]; then\n    echo \"\"\n    echo -e \"${RED}❌ Commit blocked due to large files${NC}\"\n    echo -e \"${YELLOW}To bypass (NOT RECOMMENDED): git commit --no-verify${NC}\"\n    echo \"\"\n    echo \"For more info, see: /tmp/repository_health_governance.md\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\necho -e \"${GREEN}✅ File size check passed${NC}\"\nexit 0\n"
}

     6→#   - [commit] (fast): Runs on `git commit` - ~3-5s for quick feedback
     7→#   - [push] (safety): Runs on `git push` - large files and secrets only (linting in CI)
     8→#
     9→# Usage:
    10→#   pre-commit run --all-files                   # Run all hooks, all stages
    11→#   pre-commit run --all-files --hook-stage=commit # Run only fast checks
    12→
    13→repos:
    14→  # ============================================================================
    15→  # FAST CHECKS (commit stage) - Quick syntax and formatting validation
    16→  # ============================================================================
    17→
    18→  # Ruff - Fast Python formatter and quick linter
    19→  - repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
    20→    rev: v0.15.0
    21→    hooks:
    22→      # Format check (no auto-fix on commit, just warn)
    23→      - id: ruff-format
    24→        stages: [commit]
    25→        args: [--check]
    26→      # Quick lint - only basic syntax errors and auto-fixes
    27→      - id: ruff
    28→        stages: [commit]
    29→        args: [--select=F,E9,E501, --fix]
    30→        name: ruff-quick (syntax errors only)
    31→
    32→  # General file checks - Fast validation
    33→  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    34→    rev: v5.0.0
    35→    hooks:
    36→      - id: trailing-whitespace
    37→        stages: [commit]
    38→      - id: end-of-file-fixer
    39→        stages: [commit]
    40→      - id: check-yaml
    41→        stages: [commit]
    42→      - id: check-added-large-files
    43→        args: [--maxkb=1000]
    44→        stages: [commit]
    45→      - id: check-merge-conflict
    46→        stages: [commit]
    47→      - id: detect-private-key
    48→        stages: [commit]
    49→
    50→  # ============================================================================
    51→  # PUSH STAGE - Safety checks only (comprehensive linting deferred to CI)
    52→  # ============================================================================
    53→
    54→  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    55→    rev: v5.0.0
    56→    hooks:
    57→      - id: check-added-large-files
    58→        args: [--maxkb=1000]
    59→        stages: [push]
    60→      - id: detect-private-key
    61→        stages: [push]
    62→
    63→  # Detect Secrets - Advanced credential detection
    64→  - repo: https://github.com/Yelp/detect-secrets
    65→    rev: v1.4.0
    66→    hooks:
    67→      - id: detect-secrets
    68→        stages: [push]
    69→        args: ["--baseline", ".secrets.baseline"]
    70→
    71→  # Bandit - Security linting for Python code
    72→  - repo: https://github.com/PyCQA/bandit
    73→    rev: 1.7.8
    74→    hooks:
    75→      - id: bandit
    76→        stages: [push]
    77→        args: [--severity-level=medium, --skip=B101]
    78→        language: python
    79→

  "content": "#!/bin/bash\n# Weekly repository maintenance script\n# Session 55, Task #7: Repository health governance\n# Layer 3: Remediation - automated cleanup and optimization\n#\n# Run via cron: 0 2 * * 0 (Sunday 2am)\n# Or manually: ./scripts/maintenance/weekly_repo_maintenance.sh\n\nset -e\n\n# Colors\nRED='\\033[0;31m'\nYELLOW='\\033[1;33m'\nGREEN='\\033[0;32m'\nBLUE='\\033[0;34m'\nNC='\\033[0m' # No Color\n\n# Configuration\nCOHEZION_HOME=\"${COHEZION_HOME:-/home/mike-anderson/dev/cohezion}\"\nLOG_FILE=\"${LOG_FILE:-/var/log/cohezion-repo-maintenance.log}\"\nDRY_RUN=\"${DRY_RUN:-0}\"\n\necho -e \"${BLUE}=== COHEZION Repository Maintenance ===${NC}\"\necho \"Started at: $(date)\"\necho \"Repository: $COHEZION_HOME\"\necho \"\"\n\ncd \"$COHEZION_HOME\" || exit 1\n\n# Dry run mode\nif [ \"$DRY_RUN\" -eq 1 ]; then\n    echo -e \"${YELLOW}⚠️  DRY RUN MODE - No changes will be made${NC}\"\n    echo \"\"\nfi\n\n# Check 1: Repository size before maintenance\necho -e \"${BLUE}[1/6] Checking repository size (before)...${NC}\"\nSIZE_BEFORE=$(du -sh .git | cut -f1)\nSIZE_BYTES_BEFORE=$(du -sb .git | cut -f1)\necho \"  Current size: $SIZE_BEFORE\"\necho \"\"\n\n# Check 2: Count objects\necho -e \"${BLUE}[2/6] Counting git objects...${NC}\"\ngit count-objects -vH\necho \"\"\n\n# Check 3: Clean reflog (keep 30 days)\necho -e \"${BLUE}[3/6] Cleaning reflog (keeping 30 days)...${NC}\"\nif [ \"$DRY_RUN\" -eq 0 ]; then\n    git reflog expire --expire=30.days.ago --all\n    git reflog expire --expire-unreachable=7.days.ago --all\n    echo -e \"${GREEN}  ✅ Reflog cleaned${NC}\"\nelse\n    echo -e \"${YELLOW}  (Skipped - dry run)${NC}\"\nfi\necho \"\"\n\n# Check 4: Prune remote-tracking branches\necho -e \"${BLUE}[4/6] Pruning remote branches...${NC}\"\nif [ \"$DRY_RUN\" -eq 0 ]; then\n    git remote prune origin\n    echo -e \"${GREEN}  ✅ Remote branches pruned${NC}\"\nelse\n    echo -e \"${YELLOW}  (Skipped - dry run)${NC}\"\nfi\necho \"\"\n\n# Check 5: Aggressive garbage collection\necho -e \"${BLUE}[5/6] Running git gc --aggressive...${NC}\"\necho \"  This may take several minutes...\"\nif [ \"$DRY_RUN\" -eq 0 ]; then\n    # Run with nice to avoid blocking other processes\n    nice -n 10 git gc --aggressive --prune=now\n    echo -e \"${GREEN}  ✅ Garbage collection complete${NC}\"\nelse\n    echo -e \"${YELLOW}  (Skipped - dry run)${NC}\"\nfi\necho \"\"\n\n# Check 6: Repository size after maintenance\necho -e \"${BLUE}[6/6] Checking repository size (after)...${NC}\"\nSIZE_AFTER=$(du -sh .git | cut -f1)\nSIZE_BYTES_AFTER=$(du -sb .git | cut -f1)\necho \"  Size after: $SIZE_AFTER\"\n\n# Calculate savings\nSAVED_BYTES=$((SIZE_BYTES_BEFORE - SIZE_BYTES_AFTER))\nSAVED_MB=$((SAVED_BYTES / 1024 / 1024))\n\nif [ \"$SAVED_BYTES\" -gt 0 ]; then\n    echo -e \"${GREEN}  ✅ Saved: ${SAVED_MB} MB${NC}\"\nelif [ \"$SAVED_BYTES\" -lt 0 ]; then\n    INCREASED_MB=$((-SAVED_MB))\n    echo -e \"${YELLOW}  ⚠️  Size increased: ${INCREASED_MB} MB${NC}\"\n    echo \"     (Normal after gc --aggressive due to pack rewriting)\"\nelse\n    echo \"  No change\"\nfi\necho \"\"\n\n# Report largest objects in history\necho -e \"${BLUE}=== Top 10 Largest Objects in History ===${NC}\"\ngit rev-list --objects --all | \\\n  git cat-file --batch-check='%(objecttype) %(objectname) %(objectsize) %(rest)' | \\\n  awk '$1 == \"blob\" && $3 > 1048576 {printf \"%.2f MB: %s\\n\", $3/1048576, $4}' | \\\n  sort -rn | head -10\n\necho \"\"\necho -e \"${GREEN}=== Maintenance Complete ===${NC}\"\necho \"Completed at: $(date)\"\necho \"Summary:\"\necho \"  - Before: $SIZE_BEFORE\"\necho \"  - After:  $SIZE_AFTER\"\necho \"  - Saved:  ${SAVED_MB} MB\"\necho \"\"\n\n# Warning if still large\nSIZE_GB=$((SIZE_BYTES_AFTER / 1024 / 1024 / 1024))\nif [ \"$SIZE_GB\" -gt 6 ]; then\n    echo -e \"${YELLOW}⚠️  WARNING: Repository size ($SIZE_GB GB) exceeds 6GB target${NC}\"\n    echo \"   Review large files and consider git-lfs migration\"\n    echo \"   See: /tmp/repository_health_governance.md\"\nfi\n\nexit 0\n"
}

)\n\n            scores.append(SkillScore(\n                skill_name=row['skill_name'],\n                usage_count=usage_count,\n                success_rate=success_rate,\n ExpertStream(str, Enum):\n    \"\"\"Five expert streams per Charter.\"\"\"\n    ARCHITECT = \"architect\"        # Design decisions\n    ENGINEER = \"engineer\"          # Physics/implementation\n    BIOLOGIST = \"biologist\"        # Life/organic systems\n    QUANTUM_HW = \"quantum_hw\"      # Hardware/physical layer\n    QUANTUM_ALGO = \"quantum_algo\"  # Compute/algorithms\n\nclass StreamRecommendation(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Single expert stream's recommendation.\"\"\"\n    stream: ExpertStream\n    recommendation: str\n    confidence: float\n    coherence: float      # This stream's coherence with proposal\n    rationale: str\n\nclass EDLConsensus(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Consensus across expert streams.\"\"\"\n    decision: str\n    coherence: float               # Average coherence across streams\n    hiho_stable: bool              # Within 0.4-0.6\n    consensus_strength: float      # 1.0 = perfect HIHO alignment\n    stream_recommendations: List[StreamRecommendation]\n    requires_human_review: bool\n    reasoning: str\n\nclass ExpertDomainRouter:\n    \"\"\"Route complex decisions through Expert Domain Lattice.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.client = get_compound_client()\n        self.coherence_tracker = get_coherence_tracker()\n\n    async def route_decision(\n        self,\n        decision_type: str,\n        context: str,\n        proposal: str\n    ) -> EDLConsensus:\n        \"\"\"\n        Route decision through appropriate expert streams.\n\n        Decision types:\n        - 'architecture': Architect + Engineer\n        - 'security': Engineer + Quantum HW\n        - 'performance': Engineer + Quantum Algo\n        - 'integration': Architect + Engineer + Biologist\n        - 'algorithm': Quantum Algo + Engineer\n        \"\"\"\n\n        # Determine which streams to consult\n        streams = self._select_streams(decision_type)\n\n        # Consult each stream in parallel\n        import asyncio\n        recommendations = await asyncio.gather(*[\n            self._consult_stream(stream, context, proposal)\n            for stream in streams\n        ])\n\n        # Stabilize consensus (Charter requirement: 0.5 coherence)\n        consensus = self._stabilize_consensus(recommendations)\n\n        return consensus\n\n    def _select_streams(self, decision_type: str) -> List[ExpertStream]:\n        \"\"\"Select appropriate expert streams for decision type.\"\"\"\n        stream_map = {\n            'architecture': [ExpertStream.ARCHITECT, ExpertStream.ENGINEER],\n            'security': [ExpertStream.ENGINEER, ExpertStream.QUANTUM_HW],\n            'performance': [ExpertStream.ENGINEER, ExpertStream.QUANTUM_ALGO],\n            'integration': [ExpertStream.ARCHITECT, ExpertStream.ENGINEER, ExpertStream.BIOLOGIST],\n            'algorithm': [ExpertStream.QUANTUM_ALGO, ExpertStream.ENGINEER],\n            'hardware': [ExpertStream.QUANTUM_HW, ExpertStream.ENGINEER],\n            'research': [ExpertStream.ARCHITECT, ExpertStream.BIOLOGIST],\n        }\n\n        return stream_map.get(decision_type, [ExpertStream.ARCHITECT])\n\n    async def _consult_stream(\n        self,\n        stream: ExpertStream,\n        context: str,\n        proposal: str\n    ) -> StreamRecommendation:\n        \"\"\"Consult a single expert stream.\"\"\"\n\n        # Construct prompt for expert stream\n        prompt = f\"\"\"You are the {stream.value} expert in the Expert Domain Lattice.\n\nContext: {context}\n\nProposal: {proposal}\n\nProvide your expert recommendation:\n1. Do you approve this proposal? (yes/no/conditional)\n2. What is your confidence? (0-1)\n3. What is your coherence assessment? (How well does this align with the system? 0-1)\n4. Rationale for your recommendation\n\nRespond in JSON format:\n{{\n  \"approve\": \"yes|no|conditional\",\n  \"recommendation\": \"your recommendation\",\n  \"confidence\": 0.0-1.0,\n  \"coherence\": 0.0-1.0,\n  \"rationale\": \"your reasoning\"\n}}\n\"\"\"\n\n        # Query expert stream (using appropriate model)\n        model = self._get_stream_model(stream)\n        result = await self.client.execute(\n            prompt=prompt,\n            model=model,\n            temperature=0.3  # Lower for consistency\n        )\n\n        # Parse response\n        import json\n        try:\n            response = json.loads(result['result'])\n        except:\n            # Fallback if JSON parsing fails\n            response = {\n                'approve': 'conditional',\n                'recommendation': result['result'],\n                'confidence': 0.5,\n                'coherence': 0.5,\n                'rationale': 'Expert stream response'\n            }\n\n        return StreamRecommendation(\n            stream=stream,\n            recommendation=response['recommendation'],\n            confidence=response['confidence'],\n            coherence=response['coherence'],\n            rationale=response['rationale']\n        )\n\n    def _get_stream_model(self, stream: ExpertStream) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Get appropriate model for expert stream.\"\"\"\n        # Route to different models based on expertise\n        model_map = {\n            ExpertStream.ARCHITECT: \"deepseek-r1:70b\",      # Reasoning for design\n            ExpertStream.ENGINEER: \"qwen3-coder:30b\",       # Code/implementation\n            ExpertStream.BIOLOGIST: \"deepseek-r1:70b\",      # Complex systems\n            ExpertStream.QUANTUM_HW: \"qwen3-coder:30b\",     # Hardware\n            ExpertStream.QUANTUM_ALGO: \"deepseek-r1:70b\",   # Algorithms\n        }\n        return model_map.get(stream, \"phi3:mini\")\n\n    def _stabilize_consensus(\n        self,\n        recommendations: List[StreamRecommendation]\n    ) -> EDLConsensus:\n        \"\"\"\n        Stabilize consensus using 0.5 coherence rule.\n\n        Charter: \"Trajectories are stable when consensus reached\n        across MDL, adhering to 0.5 Coherence Rule\"\n        \"\"\"\n\n        # Average coherence across streams\n        avg_coherence = sum(r.coherence for r in recommendations) / len(recommendations)\n\n        # HIHO stability check\n        hiho_stable = (0.4 <= avg_coherence <= 0.6)\n\n        # Consensus strength (1.0 at perfect 0.5 HIHO)\n        hiho_delta = abs(avg_coherence - 0.5)\n        consensus_strength = max(0.0, 1.0 - (hiho_delta * 2))\n\n        # Merge recommendations\n        merged_decision = self._merge_recommendations(recommendations)\n\n        # Requires human review if:\n        # 1. Consensus strength < 0.7 (outside HIHO)\n        # 2. Any stream has confidence < 0.5\n        # 3. Any stream explicitly rejects\n        requires_review = (\n            consensus_strength < 0.7 or\n            any(r.confidence < 0.5 for r in recommendations) or\n            any('no' in r.recommendation.lower() for r in recommendations)\n        )\n\n        # Generate reasoning\n        reasoning = self._generate_consensus_reasoning(\n            recommendations, avg_coherence, hiho_stable, consensus_strength\n        )\n\n        return EDLConsensus(\n            decision=merged_decision,\n            coherence=avg_coherence,\n            hiho_stable=hiho_stable,\n            consensus_strength=consensus_strength,\n            stream_recommendations=recommendations,\n            requires_human_review=requires_review,\n            reasoning=reasoning\n        )\n\n    def _merge_recommendations(self, recommendations: List[StreamRecommendation]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Merge recommendations from multiple streams.\"\"\"\n        # Weighted by confidence\n        weighted_recs = []\n        for rec in recommendations:\n            weighted_recs.append(f\"{rec.stream.value} ({rec.confidence:.2f}): {rec.recommendation}\")\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(weighted_recs)\n\n    def _generate_consensus_reasoning(\n        self,\n        recommendations: List[StreamRecommendation],\n        coherence: float,\n        hiho_stable: bool,\n        consensus_strength: float\n    ) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Generate human-readable consensus reasoning.\"\"\"\n\n        reasoning = f\"EDL Consensus Analysis:\\n\"\n        reasoning += f\"- Coherence: {coherence:.3f} ({'HIHO Stable ✅' if hiho_stable else 'Outside HIHO ⚠️'})\\n\"\n        reasoning += f\"- Consensus Strength: {consensus_strength:.3f}\\n\"\n        reasoning += f\"- Expert Streams Consulted: {len(recommendations)}\\n\\n\"\n\n        for rec in recommendations:\n            reasoning += f\"{rec.stream.value.upper()}:\\n\"\n            reasoning += f\"  Confidence: {rec.confidence:.2f}\\n\"\n            reasoning += f\"  Coherence: {rec.coherence:.2f}\\n\"\n            reasoning += f\"  Rationale: {rec.rationale}\\n\\n\"\n\n        return reasoning\n\n# Singleton accessor\n_edl_router = None\n\ndef get_edl_router() -> ExpertDomainRouter:\n    \"\"\"Get global EDL router instance.\"\"\"\n    global _edl_router\n    if _edl_router is None:\n        _edl_router = ExpertDomainRouter()\n    return _edl_router\n\ndef reset_edl_router():\n    \"\"\"Reset global EDL router (for testing).\"\"\"\n    global _edl_router\n    _edl_router = None\n```\n\n---\n\n## Component 3: Journey Logger\n\n**Location**: `src/cohezion/platform/journey_logger.py`\n\n```python\n\"\"\"\nJourney persistence to SurrealDB with FLUME })\n\n    async def extract_learning(\n        self,\n        journey_id: str,\n        learning: str,\n        pattern_type: str\n    ):\n        \"\"\"Extract a learning from journey.\"\"\"\n\n        await self.db.query(\"\"\"\n            UPDATE platform_journeys\n            SET learnings_extracted += [$learning]\n            WHERE journey_id = $journey_id;\n        \"\"\", {\n `src/cohezion/platform/observable_action.py`\n\n```python\n\"\"\"\nObservable AI action proposer.\nCharter requirement: \"Expose internal states and confidence levels *before* action\"\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom typing import Optional, Callable\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nclass ActionProposal(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Proposed action with full transparency.\"\"\"\n List[float]    # Current 256D latent state\n    risks: List[str]\n    benefits: List[str]\n    reversible: bool\n    auto_approvable: bool       # Can auto-approve if confidence > threshold\n\nclass current_coherence.coherence\n        )\n\n        # Create proposal\n        import uuid\n        proposal = ActionProposal(\n            action_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),\n            action_type=action_type,\n            description=description,\n            rationale=rationale,\n            confidence=confidence,\n            coherence_impact=coherence_impact,\n            flume_state=flume_state.tolist(),\n            risks=risks or [],\n            benefits=benefits or [],\n            reversible=reversible,\n            auto_approvable=(\n                confidence >          )\n\n            # Execute action\n            await action_fn()\n\n            return True\n        else:\n            print(f\"❌ Action rejected\")\n            return False\n\n    async def _display_proposal(\n        self,\n        proposal: ActionProposal,\n        current_coherence: 'CoherenceMetrics'\n    ):\n        \"\"\"Display proposal with full transparency.\"\"\"\n\n        print(f\"\"\"\n{'='*70}\nOBSERVABLE AI: ACTION PROPOSAL\n{'='*70}\n\nAction Type: {proposal.action_type}\nDescription: {proposal.description}\n\nREASONING:\n{proposal.rationale}\n\nMETRICS:\n- Confidence: {proposal.confidence:.2%}\n- Current Coherence: {current_coherence.coherence:.3f} ({'HIHO Stable ✅' if current_coherence.hiho_stable else 'Outside HIHO ⚠️'})\n- Expected Coherence Impact: data\n\n        if 'update' in description.lower() or 'patch' in description.lower():\n            return 0.01  # Small positive impact\n        elif 'refactor' in description.lower():\n            return 0.05  # Moderate positive impact\n        elif 'delete' in description.lower():\n            return -0.02  # Small negative impact\n        else:\n            return 0.0  # Neutral\n\n    def _get_current_journey_id(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Get current journey ID (from context).\"\"\"\n        # In production, would track active journey\n        # For now, return a placeholder\n        return \"current-journey-id\"\n\n# Singleton accessor\n_observable_proposer = None\n\ndef get_observable_proposer() -> ObservableActionProposer:\n    \"\"\"Get global observable proposer Component 5: FLUME Integration Layer\n\n**Location**: `src/cohezion/platform/flume_integration.py`\n\n```python\n\"\"\"\nFLUME integration for semantic encoding in 256D space.\nCharter: \"Latent trajectories in 256D spaces to predict conceptual evolution\"\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom typing import List\nimport numpy as np\nfrom cohezion.flume.vae import get_flume_vae\n\nclass FLUMEIntegrationLayer:\n    \"\"\"Wrapper for FLUME VAE integration across platform.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.vae = get_flume_vae()\n\n    def encode_text(self, text: str) -> np.ndarray:\n        \"\"\"Encode text in 256D FLUME space.\"\"\"\n        return self.vae.encode(text)\n\n    def encode_batch(self, texts: List[str]) -> np.ndarray:\n        \"\"\"Encode multiple texts in batch.\"\"\"\n        return self.vae.encode_batch(texts)\n\n    def cosine_similarity(self, embedding1: np.ndarray, embedding2: np.ndarray) -> float:\n        \"\"\"Calculate cosine similarity between two FLUME embeddings.\"\"\"\n        return float(np.dot(embedding1, embedding2) / (\n            np.linalg.norm(embedding1) * np.linalg.norm(embedding2)\n        ))\n\n    def semantic_distance(self, embedding1: np.ndarray, embedding2: np.ndarray) -> float:\n        \"\"\"Calculate semantic distance (1 - cosine similarity).\"\"\"\n        return 1.0 - self.cosine_similarity(embedding1, embedding2)\n\n    def measure_coherence(self, embedding1: np.ndarray, embedding2: np.ndarray) -> float:\n        \"\"\"\n        Measure coherence between two FLUME states.\n\n        Charter: Coherence = overlap between internal and external.\n        In FLUME space, coherence is semantic similarity.\n        \"\"\"\n        return self.cosine_similarity(embedding1, embedding2)\n\n# Singleton accessor\n_flume_layer = None\n\ndef get_flume_layer() -> FLUMEIntegrationLayer:\n    \"\"\"Get global FLUME integration layer.\"\"\"\n    global _flume_layer\n    if _flume_layer is None:\n        _flume_layer = FLUMEIntegrationLayer()\n    return _flume_layer\n```\n\n---\n\n## SurrealDB Schema\n\n**Location**: `scripts/dba/charter_compliance_schema.surql`\n\n```sql\n-- Charter platform_journeys TYPE float;\nDEFINE FIELD coherence_at_end ON platform_journeys TYPE float;\nDEFINE FIELD hiho_stable ON platform_journeys TYPE bool;\nDEFINE FIELD flume_state_start ON ((latency_ms - 500) / 500)\n            else:\n                return 0.0\n        return 0.5  # Default\n\n    async def _persist_metrics(self, metrics: CoherenceMetrics):\n        \"\"\"Persist coherence metrics to SurrealDB.\"\"\"\n        await self.db.query(\n            \"\"\"\n            CREATE coherence_metrics CONTENT {\n                timestamp: $timestamp,\n                internal_state: $internal_state,\n                external_alignment: $external_alignment,\n                coherence: $coherence,\n                hiho_stable: $hiho_stable,\n                hiho_delta: $hiho_delta,\n                stability_score: $stability_score\n            };\n        \"\"\",\n            {\n                \"timestamp\": metrics.timestamp.isoformat(),\n                \"internal_state\": metrics.internal_state,\n                \"external_alignment\": metrics.external_alignment,\n                \"coherence\": metrics.coherence,\n                \"hiho_stable\": metrics.hiho_stable,\n                \"hiho_delta\": metrics.hiho_delta,\n                \"stability_score\": metrics.stability_score,\n            },\n        )\n\n    def is_hiho_stable(self, coherence: float) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Check if coherence is within HIHO stability range.\"\"\"\n        return 0.4 <= coherence <= 0.6\n\n    async def get_coherence_trend(self, days: int = 7) -> List[float]:\n        \"\"\"Get historical coherence trend.\"\"\"\n        result = await self.db.query(\n            \"\"\"\n            SELECT coherence FROM coherence_metrics\n            WHERE timestamp >= type::datetime($start_date)\n            ORDER BY timestamp ASC;\n        \"\"\",\n            {\"start_date\": (datetime.now() - timedelta(days=days)).isoformat()},\n        )\n\n        return [m[\"coherence\"] for m in result]\n\n\n# Singleton accessor\n_coherence_tracker = None\n\n\ndef get_coherence_tracker() -> CoherenceTracker:\n    \"\"\"Get global coherence tracker instance.\"\"\"\n    global _coherence_tracker\n    if _coherence_tracker is None:\n        _coherence_tracker = CoherenceTracker()\n    return _coherence_tracker\n\n\ndef reset_coherence_tracker():\n    \"\"\"Reset global coherence tracker (for testing).\"\"\"\n    global _coherence_tracker\n    _coherence_tracker = None\n"
}

  "content": "\"\"\"\nExpert Domain Lattice routing for complex decisions.\nCharter requirement: \"All complex problems must route through five specialized streams\"\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom typing import List, Dict, Optional\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel\nfrom cohezion.swarm.compound_client import get_compound_client\nfrom cohezion.platform.coherence_tracker import get_coherence_tracker\nimport json\nimport asyncio\n\n\nclass ExpertStream(str, Enum):\n    \"\"\"Five expert streams per Charter.\"\"\"\n\n    ARCHITECT = \"architect\"  # Design decisions\n    ENGINEER = \"engineer\"  # Physics/implementation\n    BIOLOGIST = \"biologist\"  # Life/organic systems\n    QUANTUM_HW = \"quantum_hw\"  # Hardware/physical layer\n    QUANTUM_ALGO = \"quantum_algo\"  # Compute/algorithms\n\n\nclass StreamRecommendation(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Single expert stream's recommendation.\"\"\"\n\n    stream: ExpertStream\n    recommendation: str\n    confidence: float\n    coherence: float  # This stream's coherence with proposal\n    rationale: str\n\n\nclass EDLConsensus(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Consensus across expert streams.\"\"\"\n\n    decision: str\n    coherence: float  # Average coherence across streams\n    hiho_stable: bool  # Within 0.4-0.6\n    consensus_strength: float  # 1.0 = perfect HIHO alignment\n    stream_recommendations: List[StreamRecommendation]\n    requires_human_review: bool\n    reasoning: str\n\n\nclass ExpertDomainRouter:\n    \"\"\"Route complex decisions through Expert Domain Lattice.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.client = get_compound_client()\n        self.coherence_tracker = get_coherence_tracker()\n\n    async def route_decision(\n        self, decision_type: str, context: str, proposal: str\n    ) -> EDLConsensus:\n        \"\"\"\n        Route decision through appropriate expert streams.\n\n        Decision types:\n        - 'architecture': Architect + Engineer\n        - 'security': Engineer + Quantum HW\n        - 'performance': Engineer + Quantum Algo\n        - 'integration': Architect + Engineer + Biologist\n        - 'algorithm': Quantum Algo + Engineer\n        \"\"\"\n\n        # Determine which streams to consult\n        streams = self._select_streams(decision_type)\n\n        # Consult each stream in parallel\n        recommendations = await asyncio.gather(\n            *[self._consult_stream(stream, context, proposal) for stream in streams]\n        )\n\n        # Stabilize consensus (Charter requirement: 0.5 coherence)\n        consensus = self._stabilize_consensus(recommendations)\n\n        return consensus\n\n    def _select_streams(self, decision_type: str) -> List[ExpertStream]:\n        \"\"\"Select appropriate expert streams for decision type.\"\"\"\n        stream_map = {\n            \"architecture\": [ExpertStream.ARCHITECT, ExpertStream.ENGINEER],\n            \"security\": [ExpertStream.ENGINEER, ExpertStream.QUANTUM_HW],\n            \"performance\": [ExpertStream.ENGINEER, ExpertStream.QUANTUM_ALGO],\n            \"integration\": [\n                ExpertStream.ARCHITECT,\n                ExpertStream.ENGINEER,\n                ExpertStream.BIOLOGIST,\n            ],\n            \"algorithm\": [ExpertStream.QUANTUM_ALGO, ExpertStream.ENGINEER],\n            \"hardware\": [ExpertStream.QUANTUM_HW, ExpertStream.ENGINEER],\n            \"research\": [ExpertStream.ARCHITECT, ExpertStream.BIOLOGIST],\n        }\n\n        return stream_map.get(decision_type, [ExpertStream.ARCHITECT])\n\n    async def _consult_stream(\n        self, stream: ExpertStream, context: str, proposal: str\n    ) -> StreamRecommendation:\n        \"\"\"Consult a single expert stream.\"\"\"\n\n        # Construct prompt for expert stream\n        prompt = f\"\"\"You are the {stream.value} expert in the Expert Domain Lattice.\n\nContext: {context}\n\nProposal: {proposal}\n\nProvide your expert recommendation:\n1. Do you approve this proposal? (yes/no/conditional)\n2. What is your confidence? (0-1)\n3. What is your coherence assessment? (How well does this align with the system? 0-1)\n4. Rationale for your recommendation\n\nRespond in JSON format:\n{{\n  \"approve\": \"yes|no|conditional\",\n  \"recommendation\": \"your recommendation\",\n  \"confidence\": 0.0-1.0,\n  \"coherence\": 0.0-1.0,\n  \"rationale\": \"your reasoning\"\n}}\n\"\"\"\n\n        # Query expert stream (using appropriate model)\n        model = self._get_stream_model(stream)\n        result = await self.client.execute(\n            prompt=prompt, model=model, temperature=0.3  # Lower for consistency\n        )\n\n        # Parse response\n        try:\n            response = json.loads(result[\"result\"])\n        except Exception:\n            # Fallback if JSON parsing fails\n            response = {\n                \"approve\": \"conditional\",\n                \"recommendation\": result[\"result\"],\n                \"confidence\": 0.5,\n                \"coherence\": 0.5,\n                \"rationale\": \"Expert stream response\",\n            }\n\n        return StreamRecommendation(\n            stream=stream,\n            recommendation=response[\"recommendation\"],\n            confidence=response[\"confidence\"],\n            coherence=response[\"coherence\"],\n            rationale=response[\"rationale\"],\n        )\n\n    def _get_stream_model(self, stream: ExpertStream) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Get appropriate model for expert stream.\"\"\"\n        # Route to different models based on expertise\n        model_map = {\n            ExpertStream.ARCHITECT: \"deepseek-r1:70b\",  # Reasoning for design\n            ExpertStream.ENGINEER: \"qwen3-coder:30b\",  # Code/implementation\n            ExpertStream.BIOLOGIST: \"deepseek-r1:70b\",  # Complex systems\n            ExpertStream.QUANTUM_HW: \"qwen3-coder:30b\",  # Hardware\n            ExpertStream.QUANTUM_ALGO: \"deepseek-r1:70b\",  # Algorithms\n        }\n        return model_map.get(stream, \"phi3:mini\")\n\n    def _stabilize_consensus(\n        self, recommendations: List[StreamRecommendation]\n    ) -> EDLConsensus:\n        \"\"\"\n        Stabilize consensus using 0.5 coherence rule.\n\n        Charter: \"Trajectories are stable when consensus reached\n        across MDL, adhering to 0.5 Coherence Rule\"\n        \"\"\"\n\n        # Average coherence across streams\n        avg_coherence = sum(r.coherence for r in recommendations) / len(\n            recommendations\n        )\n\n        # HIHO stability check\n        hiho_stable = 0.4 <= avg_coherence <= 0.6\n\n        # Consensus strength (1.0 at perfect 0.5 HIHO)\n        hiho_delta = abs(avg_coherence - 0.5)\n        consensus_strength = max(0.0, 1.0 - (hiho_delta * 2))\n\n        # Merge recommendations\n        merged_decision = self._merge_recommendations(recommendations)\n\n        # Requires human review if:\n        # 1. Consensus strength < 0.7 (outside HIHO)\n        # 2. Any stream has confidence < 0.5\n        # 3. Any stream explicitly rejects\n        requires_review = (\n            consensus_strength < 0.7\n            or any(r.confidence < 0.5 for r in recommendations)\n            or any(\"no\" in r.recommendation.lower() for r in recommendations)\n        )\n\n        # Generate reasoning\n        reasoning = self._generate_consensus_reasoning(\n            recommendations, avg_coherence, hiho_stable, consensus_strength\n        )\n\n        return EDLConsensus(\n            decision=merged_decision,\n            coherence=avg_coherence,\n            hiho_stable=hiho_stable,\n            consensus_strength=consensus_strength,\n            stream_recommendations=recommendations,\n            requires_human_review=requires_review,\n            reasoning=reasoning,\n        )\n\n    def _merge_recommendations(\n        self, recommendations: List[StreamRecommendation]\n    ) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Merge recommendations from multiple streams.\"\"\"\n        # Weighted by confidence\n        weighted_recs = []\n        for rec in recommendations:\n            weighted_recs.append(\n                f\"{rec.stream.value} ({rec.confidence:.2f}): {rec.recommendation}\"\n            )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(weighted_recs)\n\n    def _generate_consensus_reasoning(\n        self,\n        recommendations: List[StreamRecommendation],\n        coherence: float,\n        hiho_stable: bool,\n        consensus_strength: float,\n    ) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Generate human-readable consensus reasoning.\"\"\"\n\n        reasoning = \"EDL Consensus Analysis:\\n\"\n        reasoning += f\"- Coherence: {coherence:.3f} ({'HIHO Stable ✅' if hiho_stable else 'Outside HIHO ⚠️'})\\n\"\n        reasoning += f\"- Consensus Strength: {consensus_strength:.3f}\\n\"\n        reasoning += f\"- Expert Streams Consulted: {len(recommendations)}\\n\\n\"\n\n        for rec in recommendations:\n            reasoning += f\"{rec.stream.value.upper()}:\\n\"\n            reasoning += f\"  Confidence: {rec.confidence:.2f}\\n\"\n            reasoning += f\"  Coherence: {rec.coherence:.2f}\\n\"\n            reasoning += f\"  Rationale: {rec.rationale}\\n\\n\"\n\n        return reasoning\n\n\n# Singleton accessor\n_edl_router = None\n\n\ndef get_edl_router() -> ExpertDomainRouter:\n    \"\"\"Get global EDL router instance.\"\"\"\n    global _edl_router\n    if _edl_router is None:\n        _edl_router = ExpertDomainRouter()\n    return _edl_router\n\n\ndef reset_edl_router():\n    \"\"\"Reset global EDL router (for testing).\"\"\"\n    global _edl_router\n    _edl_router = None\n"

cohezion.flume.vae_encoder import get_encoder\nfrom cohezion.platform.coherence_tracker import get_coherence_tracker\n\n\nclass Journey(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Platform journey record.\"\"\"\n\n    journey_id: str\n    journey_type: str  # 'design', 'implementation', 'decision', 'health_check'\n    timestamp: datetime\n    coherence_at_start: float\n    coherence_at_end: float\n    hiho_stable: \"\"\"Log platform journeys to SurrealDB.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.db = get_surreal_client()\n        self.vae = get_encoder()\n        self.coherence_tracker = get_coherence_tracker()\n\n    async def start_journey(self, journey_type: str, context: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"\n        Start a new journey and return journey_id.\n\n        Charter: All significant platform operations are journeys\n        that must be tracked with coherence progression.\n        \"\"\"\n\n        journey_id = str(uuid.uuid4())\n\n        # Measure starting coherence\n        coherence_metrics = await self.coherence_tracker.measure_system_coherence()\n\n        # Encode context in FLUME space\n        flume_state = self.vae.encode(context)\n\n        # Convert numpy array to list for JSON serialization\n        if isinstance(flume_state, np.ndarray):\n            flume_state = flume_state.tolist()\n\n        # Create journey record\n        await self.db.query(\n            \"\"\"\n            CREATE platform_journeys CONTENT {\n                journey_id: $journey_id,\n                journey_type: $journey_type,\n                started_at: $timestamp,\n                coherence_at_start: $coherence_start,\n                flume_state_start: $flume_state,\n                status: 'in_progress'\n            };\n        \"\"\",\n            {\n                \"journey_id\": journey_id,\n                \"journey_type\": journey_type,\n                \"timestamp\": datetime.now().isoformat(),\n                \"coherence_start\": coherence_metrics.coherence,\n                \"flume_state\": flume_state,\n            },\n        )\n\n        return journey_id\n\n    async def log_decision(self, journey_id: str, decision: str, rationale: str):\n        \"\"\"Log a decision made during journey.\"\"\"\n\n        await self.db.query(\n            \"\"\"\n            UPDATE platform_journeys\n            SET decisions_made += [$decision]\n            WHERE journey_id = $journey_id;\n        \"\"\",\n            {\n                \"journey_id\": journey_id,\n                \"decision\": {\n                    \"timestamp\": datetime.now().isoformat(),\n                    \"decision\": decision,\n                    \"rationale\": rationale,\n                },\n            },\n        )\n\n    async def extract_learning(\n        self, journey_id: str, learning: str, pattern_type: str\n    ):\n        \"\"\"Extract a learning from journey.\"\"\"\n\n        await self.db.query(\n            \"\"\"\n            UPDATE platform_journeys\n            SET learnings_extracted += [$learning]\n            WHERE journey_id = $journey_id;\n        \"\"\",\n            {\n                \"journey_id\": journey_id,\n                \"learning\": {\n                    \"timestamp\": datetime.now().isoformat(),\n                    \"learning\": learning,\n                    \"pattern_type\": pattern_type,\n                },\n            },\n        )\n\n    async def complete_journey(\n        self, journey_id: str, outcome: str, context_end: str\n    ) -> Journey:\n        \"\"\"\n        Complete journey and calculate final coherence.\n\n        Returns complete Journey record with FLUME trajectory.\n        \"\"\"\n\n        # Measure ending coherence\n        coherence_metrics = await self.coherence_tracker.measure_system_coherence()\n\n        # Encode ending context in FLUME space\n        flume_state_end = self.vae.encode(context_end)\n\n        # Convert numpy array to list for JSON serialization\n        if isinstance(flume_state_end, np.ndarray):\n            flume_state_end = flume_state_end.tolist()\n\n        # Update journey record\n        await self.db.query(\n            \"\"\"\n            UPDATE platform_journeys\n            SET\n                completed_at = $timestamp,\n                coherence_at_end = $coherence_end,\n                flume_state_end = $flume_state_end,\n                hiho_stable = $hiho_stable,\n                outcome = $outcome,\n                status = 'completed'\n            WHERE journey_id = $journey_id;\n        \"\"\",\n            {\n                \"journey_id\": journey_id,\n                \"timestamp\": datetime.now().isoformat(),\n                \"coherence_end\": coherence_metrics.coherence,\n                \"flume_state_end\": flume_state_end,\n                \"hiho_stable\": coherence_metrics.hiho_stable,\n                \"outcome\": outcome,\n            },\n        )\n\n        # Load complete journey\n        result = await self.db.query(\n            \"\"\"\n            SELECT * FROM platform_journeys\n            WHERE journey_id = $journey_id;\n        \"\"\",\n            {\"journey_id\": journey_id},\n        )\n\n        journey_data = result[0]\n\n        return Journey(\n            journey_id=journey_data[\"journey_id\"],\n            journey_type=journey_data[\"journey_type\"],\n            timestamp=datetime.fromisoformat(journey_data[\"started_at\"]),\n            coherence_at_start=journey_data[\"coherence_at_start\"],\n            coherence_at_end=journey_data.get(\"coherence_at_end\", 0.5),\n            hiho_stable=journey_data.get(\"hiho_stable\", False),\n            flume_trajectory=journey_data.get(\"flume_state_end\", l[\"learning\"] for l in journey_data.get(\"learnings_extracted\", [])\n            ],\n            outcome=journey_data.get(\"outcome\", \"\"),\n            metadata=journey_data.get(\"metadata\", {}),\n        )\n\n    async def get_recent_journeys(\n        self, journey_type: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = 10\n    ) -> List[Journey]:\n        \"\"\"Get recent journeys, optionally journey_type = $journey_type\n                ORDER BY started_at DESC\n                LIMIT $limit;\n            \"\"\",\n                {\"journey_type\": journey_type, \"limit\": limit},\n            )\n        else:\n            result = await self.db.query(\n                \"\"\"\n                SELECT * FROM platform_journeys\n                ORDER BY started_at DESC\n                LIMIT $limit;\n            \"\"\",\n                {\"limit\": limit},\n            )\n\n        journeys = []\n        for j in result:\n            journeys.append(\n                Journey(\n                    journey_id=j[\"journey_id\"],\n                    journey_type=j[\"journey_type\"],\n                    timestamp=datetime.fromisoformat(j[\"started_at\"]),\n                    coherence_at_start=j[\"coherence_at_start\"],\n                    coherence_at_end=j.get(\"coherence_at_end\", 0.5),\n                    hiho_stable=j.get(\"hiho_stable\", False),\n                    flume_trajectory=j.get(\"flume_state_end\", []),\n                    decisions_made=[\n                        d[\"decision\"] for d in j.get(\"decisions_made\", [])\n                    ],\n   1011→class FLUMEIntegrationLayer:
  1012→    """Wrapper for FLUME VAE integration across platform."""

  1015→        self.vae = get_flume_vae()

  1025→    def cosine_similarity(self, embedding1: np.ndarray, embedding2: np.ndarray) -> float:
  1026→        """Calculate cosine similarity between two FLUME embeddings."""
  1027→        return float(np.dot(embedding1, embedding2) / (
  1028→            np.linalg.norm(embedding1) * np.linalg.norm(embedding2)
  1029→        ))

Expected change to system coherence\n    flume_state: List[float]  # Current 256D latent state\n    risks: List[str]\n    benefits: List[str]\n    reversible: bool\n    auto_approvable: bool  # Can auto-approve if confidence > threshold\n\n\nclass ObservableActionProposer:\n    \"\"\"Propose actions with full transparency before execution.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.coherence_tracker = get_coherence_tracker()\n        self.journey_logger = get_journey_logger()\n        self.vae = get_encoder()\n        self._current_journey_id: Optional[str] = None\n\n    async def propose_action(\n        self,\n        action_type: str,\n        description: str,\n        rationale: str,\n        confidence: float,\n        action_fn: Callable,\n        risks: Optional[List[str]] = None,\n        benefits: Optional[List[str]] = None,\n        reversible: bool = True,\n        approval_callback: Optional[Callable[[ActionProposal], bool]] = None,\n    ) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"\n        Propose an action with full transparency.\n\n        Charter Compliance:\n        - Exposes reasoning BEFORE action\n        - Shows confidence and coherence impact\n        - Displays FLUME state\n        - Requires approval if confidence < threshold\n\n        Args:\n            action_type: Type of action (e.g., 'update', 'delete', 'refactor')\n            description: What the action does\n            rationale: Why we're doing it\n            confidence: Agent confidence (0-1)\n            action_fn: The action to execute if approved\n            risks: List of identified risks\n            benefits: List of expected benefits\n            reversible: Whether the action can be undone\n            approval_callback: Optional callback for approval (defaults to print + input)\n\n        Returns:\n            True if action was approved and executed, False otherwise\n        \"\"\"\n\n        # Measure current coherence\n        current_coherence = await self.coherence_tracker.measure_system_coherence()\n\n        # Encode current state in FLUME space\n        context = f\"{action_type}: {description}\\nRationale: {rationale}\"\n        flume_state = self.vae.encode(context)\n\n        # Convert numpy array to list for JSON serialization\n        if isinstance(flume_state, np.ndarray):\n            flume_state = flume_state.tolist()\n\n        # Estimate coherence impact\n        coherence_impact = await self._estimate_coherence_impact(\n            action_type, description, current_coherence.coherence\n        )\n\n        # Create proposal\n        proposal = ActionProposal(\n            action_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),\n            action_type=action_type,\n            description=description,\n            rationale=rationale,\n            confidence=confidence,\n            coherence_impact=coherence_impact,\n            flume_state=flume_state,\n            risks=risks or [],\n            benefits=benefits or [],\n            reversible=reversible,\n            auto_approvable=(\n                confidence > 0.9 and reversible and abs(coherence_impact) < 0.1\n            ),  # Small impact\n        )\n\n        # Display proposal (Observable AI)\n        await self._display_proposal(proposal, current_coherence)\n\n        # Auto-approve or request approval\n        if proposal.auto_approvable:\n            print(f\"✅ AUTO-APPROVED (confidence {confidence:.2f} > 0.9)\")\n            approved = True\n        else:\n            if approval_callback:\n                approved = approval_callback(proposal)\n            else:\n                approved = await self._request_approval(proposal)\n\n        if approved:\n            # Log decision to current journey (if one exists)\n            if self._current_journey_id:\n                try:\n                    await self.journey_logger.log_decision(\n                        journey_id=self._current_journey_id,\n                        decision=description,\n                        rationale=rationale,\n                    )\n                except Exception:\n                    # Non-blocking if journey doesn't exist\n                    pass\n\n            # Execute action\n            await action_fn()\n\n            return True\n        else:\n            print(\"❌ Action rejected\")\n            return False\n\n    async def _display_proposal(\n        self, proposal: ActionProposal, current_coherence: CoherenceMetrics\n    ):\n        \"\"\"Display proposal with full transparency.\"\"\"\n\n        print(\n            f\"\"\"\n{'='*70}\nOBSERVABLE AI: ACTION PROPOSAL\n{'='*70}\n\nAction Type: {proposal.action_type}\nDescription: {proposal.description}\n\nREASONING:\n{proposal.rationale}\n\nMETRICS:\n- Confidence: {proposal.confidence:.2%}\n- Current Coherence: {current_coherence.coherence:.3f} ({'HIHO Stable ✅' if current_coherence.hiho_stable else 'Outside HIHO ⚠️'})\n- Expected Coherence Impact: {proposal.coherence_impact:+.3f}\n- New Coherence: ~{current_coherence.coherence + proposal.coherence_impact:.3f}\n- Reversible: {'Yes ✅' if proposal.reversible else 'No ⚠️'}\n\nFLUME STATE (256D):\n{proposal.flume_state[:5]}... (showing first 5 dimensions)\n\nRISKS:\n{chr(10).join('- ' + r for r in proposal.risks) if proposal.risks else '- None identified'}\n\nBENEFITS:\n{chr(10).join('- ' + b for b in proposal.benefits) if proposal.benefits else '- None specified'}\n\nDECISION:\n{'AUTO-APPROVABLE (high confidence, reversible, low impact)' if proposal.auto_approvable else 'REQUIRES APPROVAL (low confidence or high impact)'}\n\n{'='*70}\n\"\"\"\n        )\n\n    async def _request_approval(self, proposal: ActionProposal) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Request human approval for action.\"\"\"\n        # In production, this would integrate with UI/CLI approval system\n        # For testing, we can provide a callback or simulate\n        try:\n            response = input(\"Approve this action? (yes/no): \").strip().lower()\n            return response in [\"yes\", \"y\"]\n        except EOFError:\n            # Non-interactive environment (e.g., tests)\n            return False\n\n    async def _estimate_coherence_impact(\n        self, action_type: str, description: str, current_coherence: float\n    ) -> float:\n        \"\"\"Estimate impact on system coherence.\"\"\"\n\n        # Simplified heuristic\n        # In production, would use ML model or historical data\n\n        description_lower = description.lower()\n\n        if \"update\" in description_lower or \"patch\" in description_lower:\n            return 0.01  # Small positive impact\n        elif \"refactor\" in description_lower:\n            return 0.05  # Moderate positive impact\n        elif \"delete\" in description_lower:\n            return -0.02  # Small negative impact\n        else:\n            return 0.0  # Neutral\n\n    def set_current_journey(self, journey_id: str):\n        \"\"\"Set the current journey ID for logging decisions.\"\"\"\n        self._current_journey_id = journey_id\n\n    def get_current_journey_id(self) -> Optional[str]:\n        \"\"\"Get current journey ID.\"\"\"\n        return self._current_journey_id\n\n\n# Singleton accessor\n_observable_proposer = None\n\n\ndef get_observable_proposer() -> ObservableActionProposer:\n    \"\"\"Get global observable proposer instance.\"\"\"\n    global _observable_proposer\n    if _observable_proposer is None:\n        _observable_proposer = ObservableActionProposer()\n    return _observable_proposer\n\n\ndef reset_observable_proposer():\n    \"\"\"Reset global observable proposer (for testing).\"\"\"\n    global _observable_proposer\n    _observable_proposer = None\n"
