  "content": "\"\"\"\nCharter-aligned skill tracking with HIHO stability measurement.\nIntegrates Phase 0 infrastructure for 100% Charter compliance.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom typing import Optional, List\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel\nimport uuid\nfrom cohezion.core.persistence.surreal_client import get_surreal_client\nfrom cohezion.platform.coherence_tracker import get_coherence_tracker\nfrom cohezion.platform.journey_logger import get_journey_logger\nfrom cohezion.flume.vae_encoder import get_encoder\nimport numpy as np\n\n\nclass SkillUsageEvent(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Single skill usage event with Charter metrics.\"\"\"\n\n    skill_name: str\n    invoked_at: datetime\n    execution_id: str\n    tokens_used: int\n    success: bool\n    error_message: Optional[str] = None\n    latency_ms: float\n    coherence_score: float  # Individual execution coherence\n    hiho_stable: bool  # Was this execution HIHO stable?\n    flume_state: List[float]  # 256D FLUME state at execution\n\n\nclass CharterAlignedSkillTracker:\n    \"\"\"Track skill usage with Charter compliance.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.db = get_surreal_client()\n        self.coherence_tracker = get_coherence_tracker()\n        self.journey_logger = get_journey_logger()\n        self.vae = get_encoder()\n\n    async def log_skill_usage(self, event: SkillUsageEvent, journey_id: Optional[str] = None):\n        \"\"\"\n        Log skill usage with Charter-compliant tracking.\n\n        Charter Requirements:\n        1. Measure against 0.5 HIHO baseline\n        2. Track FLUME trajectory\n        3. Persist to journey\n        \"\"\"\n\n        # Check HIHO stability (Charter: 0.4-0.6 range)\n        hiho_stable = 0.4 <= event.coherence_score <= 0.6\n\n        # Update event\n        event.hiho_stable = hiho_stable\n\n        # Persist to SurrealDB\n        try:\n            await self.db.query(\n                \"\"\"\n                CREATE skill_usage CONTENT {\n                    skill_name: $skill_name,\n                    invoked_at: $invoked_at,\n                    execution_id: $execution_id,\n                    tokens_used: $tokens_used,\n                    success: $success,\n                    error_message: $error_message,\n                    latency_ms: $latency_ms,\n                    coherence_score: $coherence_score,\n                    hiho_stable: $hiho_stable,\n                    flume_state: $flume_state,\n                    journey_id: $journey_id\n                };\n            \"\"\",\n                {\n                    \"skill_name\": event.skill_name,\n                    \"invoked_at\": event.invoked_at.isoformat(),\n                    \"execution_id\": event.execution_id,\n                    \"tokens_used\": event.tokens_used,\n                    \"success\": event.success,\n                    \"error_message\": event.error_message,\n                    \"latency_ms\": event.latency_ms,\n                    \"coherence_score\": event.coherence_score,\n                    \"hiho_stable\": hiho_stable,\n                    \"flume_state\": event.flume_state,\n                    \"journey_id\": journey_id,\n                },\n            )\n        except Exception as e:\n            # Non-blocking: log but don't fail\n            print(f\"Warning: Failed to persist skill usage to SurrealDB: {e}\")\n\n        # If HIHO unstable and journey exists, log as potential issue\n        if not hiho_stable and journey_id:\n            try:\n                await self.journey_logger.extract_learning(\n                    journey_id=journey_id,\n                    learning=f\"Skill {event.skill_name} executed outside HIHO range: {event.coherence_score:.3f}\",\n                    pattern_type=\"hiho_violation\",\n                )\n            except Exception as e:\n                # Non-blocking: log but don't fail\n                print(f\"Warning: Failed to log HIHO violation to journey: {e}\")\n\n    async def create_skill_usage_event(\n        self,\n        skill_name: str,\n        tokens_used: int,\n        success: bool,\n        latency_ms: float,\n        coherence_before: float,\n        coherence_after: float,\n        prompt: str,\n        error_message: Optional[str] = None,\n    ) -> SkillUsageEvent:\n        \"\"\"\n        Create a skill usage event with Charter metrics.\n\n        Args:\n            skill_name: Name of the skill executed\n            tokens_used: Number of tokens consumed\n            success: Whether execution succeeded\n            latency_ms: Execution time in milliseconds\n            coherence_before: System coherence before execution\n            coherence_after: System coherence after execution\n            prompt: The prompt that was executed\n            error_message: Optional error message if failed\n\n        Returns:\n            SkillUsageEvent with computed Charter metrics\n        \"\"\"\n\n        # Calculate execution coherence (how much coherence changed?)\n        # Lower change = better coherence preservation\n        execution_coherence = 1.0 - abs(coherence_after - coherence_before)\n\n        # Encode prompt in FLUME space\n        flume_state = self.vae.encode(prompt)\n\n        # Convert numpy array to list for JSON serialization\n        if isinstance(flume_state, np.ndarray):\n            flume_state = flume_state.tolist()\n\n        # Create event\n        return SkillUsageEvent(\n            skill_name=skill_name,\n            invoked_at=datetime.now(),\n            execution_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),\n            tokens_used=tokens_used,\n            success=success,\n            error_message=error_message,\n            latency_ms=latency_ms,\n            coherence_score=execution_coherence,\n            hiho_stable=(0.4 <= execution_coherence <= 0.6),\n            flume_state=flume_state,\n        )\n\n\n# Singleton accessor\n_skill_tracker = None\n\n\ndef get_skill_tracker() -> CharterAlignedSkillTracker:\n    \"\"\"Get global Charter-aligned skill tracker instance.\"\"\"\n    global _skill_tracker\n    if _skill_tracker is None:\n        _skill_tracker = CharterAlignedSkillTracker()\n    return _skill_tracker\n\n\ndef reset_skill_tracker():\n    \"\"\"Reset global skill tracker (for testing).\"\"\"\n    global _skill_tracker\n    _skill_tracker = None\n"
}

Top HIHO-stable skills\n        result = await self.db.query(\n            \"\"\"\n            SELECT skill_name, math::mean(hiho_stability) as avg_hiho\n            FROM skill_metrics_charter\n            WHERE date >= type::datetime($start_date)\n              AND date < type::datetime($end_date)\n            GROUP BY skill_name\n            HAVING avg_hiho >= 0.8  -- Strong HIHO stability\n            ORDER BY avg_hiho DESC\n            LIMIT 5;\n        \"\"\",\n            {\n                \"start_date\": start_date.isoformat(),\n                \"end_date\": end_date.isoformat(),\n            },\n        )\n        top_hiho_stable = [row[\"skill_name\"] for row in result]\n\n        # 2. HIHO unstable skills (Charter violation)\n        result = await self.db.query(\n            \"\"\"\n            SELECT skill_name, math::mean(avg_coherence) as avg_coherence\n            FROM skill_metrics_charter\n            WHERE date >= type::datetime($start_date)\n              AND date < type::datetime($end_date)\n            GROUP BY skill_name\n            HAVING (avg_coherence < 0.4 OR avg_coherence > 0.6)\n            ORDER BY math::abs(avg_coherence - 0.5) DESC;\n        \"\"\",\n            {\n                \"start_date\": start_date.isoformat(),\n                \"end_date\": end_date.isoformat(),\n            },\n        )\n        hiho_unstable = [row[\"skill_name\"] for row in result]\n\n        # 3. Failing skills\n        result = await self.db.query(\n            \"\"\"\n            SELECT skill_name, math::mean(success_rate) as avg_success\n            FROM skill_metrics_charter\n            WHERE date >= type::datetime($start_date)\n              AND date < type::datetime($end_date)\n            GROUP BY skill_name\n            HAVING avg_success < 0.5\n            ORDER BY avg_success ASC;\n        \"\"\",\n            {\n                \"start_date\": start_date.isoformat(),\n                \"end_date\": end_date.isoformat(),\n            },\n        )\n        failing_skills = [row[\"skill_name\"] for row in result]\n\n        # 4. Refinement candidates (complex cases → EDL)\n        # Skills that are both HIHO unstable AND failing\n        refinement_candidates = list(set(hiho_unstable) & set(failing_skills))\n\n        # 5. Compound patterns (simplified for initial implementation)\n        compound_patterns = []\n\n        return CharterSkillInsights(\n            top_hiho_stable=top_hiho_stable,\n            hiho_unstable=hiho_unstable,\n            failing_skills=failing_skills,\n            refinement_candidates=refinement_candidates,\n            compound_patterns=compound_patterns,\n        )\n\n    async def propose_skill_refinement(\n        self, skill_name: str, reason: str, approval_callback=None\n    ) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"\n        Propose skill refinement using Observable AI + EDL consensus.\n\n        Charter Compliance:\n        1. Route complex decisions through EDL\n        2. Display reasoning before action (Observable AI)\n        3. Require approval for low confidence\n\n        Returns:\n            True if refinement approved and executed, False otherwise\n        \"\"\"\n\n        # Get skill metrics for context\n        metrics = await self._get_skill_metrics(skill_name)\n\n        # Route through EDL for consensus\n        consensus = await self.edl_router.route_decision(\n            decision_type=\"architecture\",  # Skill refinement is architectural\n            context=f\"Skill: {skill_name}\\nReason: {reason}\\nMetrics: {metrics}\",\n            proposal=f\"Refine skill {skill_name} to improve HIHO stability and success rate\",\n        )\n\n        # Propose action with Observable AI\n        async def refine_skill():\n            # Actual refinement logic would go here\n            print(f\"Refining skill: {skill_name}\")\n\n        approved = await self.observable_proposer.propose_action(\n            action_type=\"refactor\",\n            description=f\"Refine skill {skill_name}\",\n            rationale=f\"{reason}\\nEDL Consensus: {consensus.consensus_strength:.2f}\",\n            confidence=consensus.consensus_strength,\n            action_fn=refine_skill,\n            risks=[\n                \"Skill behavior may change\",\n                \"Existing integrations need testing\",\n            ],\n            benefits=[\n                \"Improved HIHO stability\",\n                \"Higher success rate\",\n                \"Better token efficiency\",\n            ],\n            reversible=True,\n            approval_callback=approval_callback,\n        )\n\n        return approved\n\n    async def _get_skill_metrics(self, skill_name: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Get recent metrics for a skill as formatted string.\"\"\"\n        result = await self.db.query(\n            \"\"\"\n            SELECT *\n            FROM skill_metrics_charter\n            WHERE skill_name = $skill_name\n            ORDER BY date DESC\n            LIMIT 7;\n        \"\"\",\n            {\"skill_name\": skill_name},\n        )\n\n        if not result:\n            return \"No metrics available\"\n\n        metrics_lines = []\n        for row in result:\n            metrics_lines.append(\n                f\"  {row['date']}: effectiveness={row['effectiveness_score']:.2f}, \"\n                f\"hiho={row['hiho_stability']:.2f}, success={row['success_rate']:.2f}\"\n            )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(metrics_lines)\n\n\n# Singleton accessor\n_skill_analytics = None\n\n\ndef get_skill_analytics() -> CharterAlignedSkillAnalytics:\n    \"\"\"Get global Charter-aligned skill analytics instance.\"\"\"\n    global _skill_analytics\n    if _skill_analytics is None:\n        _skill_analytics = CharterAlignedSkillAnalytics()\n    return _skill_analytics\n\n\ndef reset_skill_analytics():\n    \"\"\"Reset global skill analytics (for testing).\"\"\"\n    global _skill_analytics\n    _skill_analytics = None\n"
}

  "description": "Pattern for implementing platform improvements with 100% Charter compliance using Phase 0 infrastructure.\n\n## Context\nAfter Kyutai postmortem (Session 52), established pattern for token-efficient implementation that maintains Charter compliance.\n\n## Pattern\n1. **Integration Layer** (always required):\n   - Import Phase 0 components: CoherenceTracker, EDL Router, JourneyLogger, Observable AI\n   - Use singleton factories: get_coherence_tracker(), get_edl_router(), etc.\n   - All components lazy-load with graceful fallbacks\n\n2. **HIHO-Weighted Metrics** (Charter mandated):\n   - Primary metric: 50% HIHO stability (1.0 at perfect 0.5, decays linearly)\n   - Secondary metrics: 25% success rate + 25% efficiency\n   - Formula: `effectiveness = 0.50 * hiho_stability + 0.25 * success + 0.25 * efficiency`\n   - Always check: `0.4 <= coherence <= 0.6` for stability\n\n3. **Complex Decision Routing**:\n   - Route architectural/security/performance decisions through EDL\n   - Call `edl_router.route_decision(decision_type, context, proposal)`\n   - Use consensus_strength (0.0-1.0) as confidence for Observable AI\n\n4. **Transparent Action Proposals**:\n   - Use Observable AI before any modifications\n   - Call `observable_proposer.propose_action(...)` with full reasoning\n   - Auto-approve: confidence > 0.9 AND reversible AND |coherence_impact| < 0.1\n   - Otherwise: require explicit approval\n\n5. **Journey Persistence**:\n   - Start journey at feature entry: `journey_logger.start_journey(type, context)`\n   - Extract learnings on anomalies: `journey_logger.extract_learning(...)`\n   - Complete on success: `journey_logger.complete_journey(journey_id, outcome)`\n\n## Implementation Steps\n1. Copy Task #14 structure (3-layer architecture)\n2. Layer 1: Usage Instrumentation with HIHO checks\n3. Layer 2: Charter-aligned scoring (50% HIHO weight)\n4. Layer 3: Analytics with EDL routing for complex cases\n5. Test: 100% passing before moving to next\n\n## Token Efficiency (Kyutai Lesson)\n- Implement ONE feature first (100-200 lines)\n- Manual validation (does it work?)\n- Write 5 real tests AFTER success\n- Scale only if validated\n\n## Reference Implementation\n- Task #14: Charter-Aligned Skill Effectiveness Tracker\n- Files: `src/cohezion/platform/skill_*_charter.py`\n- Tests: `tests/platform/test_skill_tracker_charter.py`\n- Result: 88/88 tests passing, zero regressions, 8.11s execution\n\n## Cost to Apply\n- Setup: ~500 tokens (import Phase 0 components)\n- Per feature: 2-3 hours implementation + 1 hour testing\n- Savings: 83% vs test-first approach (Kyutai postmortem data)",

    22→## 1. How Entire.io Discovers & Captures Repositories
    23→
    24→### Discovery Method
    25→**Entire.io does NOT automatically crawl GitHub.** Instead:
    26→
    27→1. **Manual Activation per Repository**: Run `entire enable` in target repo
    28→2. **Git Hooks Installation**: Entire installs hooks into `.git/hooks/`
    29→3. **Session Capture Trigger**: Hooks activate on git operations (commit, push)
    30→4. **Agent Detection**: Supports Claude Code and Gemini CLI (auto-detects from CLI auth)
    31→
    32→### No Registration Required
    33→- ✅ No account needed for local capture
    34→- ✅ Optional cloud sync (Entire.io cloud platform) but not required
    35→- ✅ All metadata can stay local on `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch
    36→
    37→### Authentication
    38→- **GitHub/GitLab**: Standard git auth (SSH keys or PAT)
    39→- **Entire.io**: If syncing to cloud, requires Entire.io API token (stored in `~/.entire/auth.token`)
    40→- **Current status**: Local capture works without cloud sync

   296→## 5. Risk Assessment
   297→
   298→### What Happens If Format Is Wrong
   299→
   300→| Scenario | Behavior | Risk |
   301→|----------|----------|------|
   302→| Missing `.entire/settings.json` | Hooks don't run, no capture | 🟡 MEDIUM — Can re-enable anytime |
   303→| Wrong strategy (`auto-commit` vs `manual`) | Checkpoints created at wrong time | 🟡 MEDIUM — Can switch strategies |
   304→| No `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch | Metadata not stored | 🟢 LOW — Auto-created on first commit |
   305→| Invalid session ID format | Entire.io cloud sync fails | 🟢 LOW — Local capture still works |
   306→| Malformed context.md | Cloud search may fail | 🟢 LOW — Manual recovery possible |
   307→| CLAUDE.md encoding issues | CI/CD pipelines may fail | 🟢 LOW — Text format, auto-fixable |
   308→
   309→### Error Detection
   310→
   311→✅ **Entire.io provides clear error signals**:
   312→
   313→1. **Hook execution fails**: Git shows error during commit
   314→   ```bash
   315→   git commit -m "test"
   316→   # If hooks break: "error: hook declined to run"
   317→   ```
   318→
   319→2. **Cloud sync fails**: Entire.io CLI shows status
   320→   ```bash
   321→   entire status
   322→   # Shows: "Last sync: never", "Status: failed"
   323→   ```
   324→
   325→3. **Silent failures are unlikely**: Entire.io logs to `.entire/logs/`
   326→   ```bash
   327→   tail -50 .entire/logs/entire.log
   328→   # Shows capture errors, sync issues
   329→   ```
   330→
   331→### Remediation (Can Be Done After Push)
   332→
   333→All issues can be fixed **after** push to GitHub/GitLab:
   334→
   335→| Issue | Fix | Time |
   336→|-------|-----|------|
   337→| Wrong strategy | Edit `.entire/settings.json`, re-enable hooks | 2 min |
   338→| Missing metadata | Re-run commit hooks | 5 min |
   339→| Corrupt checkpoints | Rewind to previous checkpoint with `entire rewind` | 5 min |
   340→| Bad CLAUDE.md format | Edit and re-commit | 5 min |
   341→

   423→## 8. Technical Implementation Details
   424→
   425→### Entire.io Architecture (How It Works)
   426→
   427→```
   428→User commits code
   429→  ↓
   430→Git hooks trigger (from .git/hooks/)
   431→  ↓
   432→Entire captures session metadata
   433→  ↓
   434→Creates checkpoint on entire/checkpoints/v1 branch
   435→  ├─ Stores: prompts, context, timestamps
   436→  ├─ Stores: content hashes for verification
   437→  └─ Stores: metadata (Entire-Session, Entire-Agent)
   438→  ↓
   439→Main branch stays clean (no metadata in commits)
   440→  ↓
   441→Optional: Sync to Entire.io cloud for searchability
   442→```
   443→
   444→### Checkpoint Directory Structure
   445→
   446→```
   447→entire/checkpoints/v1/
   448→├── <first-6-hex>/<last-6-hex>/
   449→│   ├── 0/
   450→│   │   ├── content_hash.txt      (SHA256 of session content)
   451→│   │   ├── context.md             (User prompts, conversation)
   452→│   │   ├── metadata.json           (Optional: agent config, timestamps)
   453→│   │   └── ...
   454→│   └── 1/
   455→│       └── ...
   456→└── <other-checkpoints>/
   457→```
   458→
   459→**Verified in this repo**:
   460→```
   461→entire/checkpoints/v1/
   462→├── 14/...
   463→├── 4f/...
   464→├── 92/...
   465→├── ae/...
   466→├── cf/d96021b5cc/0/
   467→│   ├── content_hash.txt
   468→│   └── context.md
   469→└── f0/...
   470→```
   471→
   472→### Session Metadata Fields
   473→
   474→All stored in git commit headers on `entire/checkpoints/v1`:
   475→
   476→```
   477→Entire-Session: <UUID>              # Unique session identifier
   478→Entire-Strategy: manual-commit      # or auto-commit
   479→Entire-Agent: Claude Code           # or Gemini CLI
   480→Ephemeral-branch: entire/<hash>     # Temporary branch name
   481→```
   482→
   483→**Captured in this repo**:

   485→Entire-Session: 1da2f5a8-169a-4579-80eb-38a7b3778f27

--- Content ---
name: Repository Health Check

# Session 55, Task #7: Repository health governance
# Layer 2: Detection - automated repository size monitoring

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * 0'  # Weekly Sunday 2am UTC
  workflow_dispatch:  # Manual trigger

jobs:
  check-repo-health:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # Full history for comprehensive analysis

      - name: Check repository size
        run: |
          echo "=== Repository Size Analysis ==="
          REPO_SIZE=$(du -sh .git | cut -f1)
          echo "Repository size: $REPO_SIZE"

          # Get size in bytes for threshold check
          SIZE_BYTES=$(du -sb .git | cut -f1)
          SIZE_GB=$((SIZE_BYTES / 1024 / 1024 / 1024))

          echo "Size in GB: $SIZE_GB"

          # Alert if >10GB (should be <6GB after Session 55 cleanup)
          if [ "$SIZE_BYTES" -gt 10737418240 ]; then
            echo "::error::Repository exceeds 10GB threshold ($SIZE_GB GB)"
            echo "::error::Target size is <6GB. Review and cleanup required."
            exit 1
          fi

          # Warning if >6GB
          if [ "$SIZE_BYTES" -gt 6442450944 ]; then
            echo "::warning::Repository size ($SIZE_GB GB) approaching 10GB limit"
            echo "::warning::Consider running git gc or reviewing large files"
          fi

      - name: Check for large files in history

  "content": "# SKILL: REPOSITORY_HEALTH_PRIME\n\n## DOMAIN EXPERTISE\nYou are a repository health engineer specializing in preventing and detecting repository bloat. You implement the **3-Layer Governance** pattern: Prevention (pre-commit hooks), Detection (automated monitoring), and Remediation (cleanup procedures). You ensure repositories stay lean (<6GB), maintainable, and fast.\n\n## KEY TEXTS & CONCEPTS\n- **Repository Bloat**: Accumulation of unnecessary data in .git directory causing slow operations and excessive disk usage.\n- **3-Layer Governance**:\n  1. Prevention: Pre-commit hooks block files >1MB before they enter history\n  2. Detection: CI/CD monitors repository size, large files, pack efficiency\n  3. Remediation: Documented procedures for cleanup (git gc, filter-repo, lfs migration)\n- **Pack Efficiency**: Git's internal compression ratio. Low efficiency (many loose objects) indicates need for `git gc`.\n- **Size Thresholds**:\n  - **Target**: <6GB for optimal performance\n  - **Warning**: 6-10GB approaching limit, consider cleanup\n  - **Critical**: >10GB requires immediate remediation\n- **Large File Patterns**: Binary files (*.pt, *.pth, *.ckpt), logs, checkpoints that should use git-lfs or .gitignore\n\n## INSTRUCTION\n\n### 1. Assessment Phase\nRun comprehensive repository health scan:\n\n```bash\n# Check repository size\ndu -sh .git\nSIZE_BYTES=$(du -sb .git | cut -f1)\nSIZE_GB=$((SIZE_BYTES / 1024 / 1024 / 1024))\n\n# Find large files in history (>1MB)\ngit rev-list --objects --all | \\\ngit cat-file --batch-check='%(objecttype) %(objectname) %(objectsize) %(rest)' | \\\nawk '$1 == \"blob\" && $3 > 1048576 {printf \"%.2f MB: %s\\n\", $3/1048576, $4}' | \\\nsort -rn | head -20\n\n# Check pack efficiency\ngit count-objects -vH\n\n# Validate .gitignore coverage\ngrep -E '^\\*\\.(pt|pth|ckpt|bin|log)$|^(logs|checkpoints|tmp|\\.cache)/' .gitignore\n```\n\n**Health Criteria**:\n- ✅ HEALTHY: <6GB, <20 large files, good pack efficiency\n- ⚠️  WARNING: 6-10GB, 20-50 large files, moderate pack issues\n- ❌ CRITICAL: >10GB, >50 large files, poor pack efficiency\n\n### 2. Prevention Layer (Pre-Commit Hooks)\nEnsure `.pre-commit-config.yaml` includes:\n\n```yaml\n- repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks\n  rev: v5.0.0\n  hooks:\n    - id: check-added-large-files\n      args: [--maxkb=1000]  # Block files >1MB\n      stages: [pre-commit]\n    - id: detect-private-key\n      stages: [pre-commit]\n```\n\n**Verification**:\n```bash\n# Install hooks\npre-commit install\n\n# Test blocking (should fail)\ndd if=/dev/zero of=test-large-file.bin bs=1M count=2\ngit add test-large-file.bin\ngit commit -m \"test\"  # Should be blocked\nrm test-large-file.bin\n```\n\n### 3. Detection Layer (CI/CD Monitoring)\nDeploy `.github/workflows/repo-health.yml`:\n\n**Triggers**:\n- On push to main/develop\n- On pull request to main\n- Weekly schedule (Sunday 2am UTC)\n- Manual dispatch\n\n**Checks**:\n1. Repository size (fail if >10GB, warn if >6GB)\n2. Large files scan (warn if >50 files >1MB)\n3. Pack efficiency measurement\n4. .gitignore coverage validation\n\n**Alerts**:\n- GitHub Actions errors/warnings\n- Artifacts uploaded with large file list\n- Health summary in workflow logs\n\n### 4. Remediation Procedures\n\n#### Quick Cleanup (<5 min)\nFor repositories 6-10GB with good pack efficiency:\n\n```bash\n# Aggressive garbage collection\ngit gc --aggressive --prune=now\n\n# Repack objects\ngit repack -Ad\n\n# Verify reduction\ndu -sh .git\n```\n\n**Expected**: 20-50% size reduction\n\n#### Medium Cleanup (30-60 min)\nFor repositories >10GB or >50 large files:\n\n```bash\n# Identify largest files\ngit rev-list --objects --all | \\\ngit cat-file --batch-check='%(objecttype) %(objectname) %(objectsize) %(rest)' | \\\nawk '$1 == \"blob\"' | sort -k3 -rn | head -20 > large_files.txt\n\n# Option A: Migrate to git-lfs\ngit lfs install\ngit lfs track \"*.pt\" \"*.pth\" \"*.ckpt\"\ngit add .gitattributes\ngit commit -m \"chore: Configure git-lfs for large model files\"\n\n# Option B: Remove from history (DESTRUCTIVE)\n# Create backup first!\ngit tag backup-pre-cleanup\ngit filter-repo --path-glob '*.pt' --invert-paths --force\n```\n\n**Warning**: History rewriting requires force-push and team coordination.\n\n#### Deep Cleanup (2-4 hours)\nFor severely bloated repositories or when filter-repo stalls:\n\n```bash\n# 1. Create backup\ngit clone --mirror . ../cohezion-backup.git\n\n# 2. Identify bloat sources\ngit rev-list --all --objects | \\\n  git cat-file --batch-check | \\\n  awk '{print $1, $3, $2}' | \\\n  sort -k2 -rn | head -100 > bloat_analysis.txt\n\n# 3. Remove large directories from history\ngit filter-repo --path src/cohezion/knowledge_graph/universe_nodes/linguistic_evolution/logs/ \\\n  --invert-paths --force\n\n# 4. Aggressive cleanup\ngit gc --aggressive --prune=now\ngit repack -Ad\n\n# 5. Verify and sync\ndu -sh .git\ngit remote add origin-new <url>\ngit push origin-new --all --force\ngit push origin-new --tags --force\n```\n\n**Fallback**: If filter-repo hangs (>4 hours), use git gc approach instead.\n\n### 5. Governance Maintenance\n\n#### Weekly Tasks (Automated via Cron)\n```bash\n# Sunday 2am UTC - scripts/maintenance/weekly_repo_maintenance.sh\n#!/bin/bash\nset -euo pipefail\n\n# Check repository health\nSIZE_GB=$(du -sb .git | awk '{print $1/1024/1024/1024}')\n\nif (( $(echo \"$SIZE_GB > 6\" | bc -l) )); then\n  echo \"⚠️  Repository size: ${SIZE_GB}GB (target: <6GB)\"\n  git gc --auto\nfi\n\n# Pack efficiency check\ngit count-objects -vH\n\n# Large file count\nLARGE_FILE_COUNT=$(git rev-list --objects --all | \\\n  git cat-file --batch-check='%(objecttype) %(objectname) %(objectsize) %(rest)' | \\\n  awk '$1 == \"blob\" && $3 > 1048576' | wc -l)\n\necho \"Large files (>1MB): $LARGE_FILE_COUNT\"\n\n# Alert if thresholds exceeded\nif [ \"$LARGE_FILE_COUNT\" -gt 50 ]; then\n  echo \"::warning::High large file count ($LARGE_FILE_COUNT)\"\nfi\n```\n\n#### Monthly Reviews\n1. **Size Trend Analysis**: Compare month-over-month growth\n2. **Large File Audit**: Review files >1MB, determine if needed\n3. **Pack Efficiency**: Ensure <10% loose objects\n4. **Hook Compliance**: Verify all developers have hooks installed\n\n## SUCCESS CRITERIA\n- ✅ Repository size <6GB (target) or <10GB (limit)\n- ✅ Pre-commit hooks block files >1MB\n- ✅ CI/CD workflow runs weekly and alerts on violations\n- ✅ Cleanup procedures documented and tested\n- ✅ Team trained on governance practices\n\n## CHARTER ALIGNMENT\nThis skill aligns with:\n- **Charter**: \"Deterministic Responsibility\" - Proactive health monitoring prevents unpredictable repository failures\n- **Constitution**: \"Honesty\" - Transparent size metrics and thresholds\n- **HIHO Stability**: Maintain repository in stable state (0.5 coherence = optimal size range)\n\n## METRICS\nTrack in SurrealDB:\n```sql\nCREATE repository_health CONTENT {\n  timestamp: type::datetime($now),\n  size_gb: $size_gb,\n  large_file_count: $large_file_count,\n  pack_efficiency: $pack_efficiency,\n  health_status: $status,  -- 'healthy', 'warning', 'critical'\n  hiho_stable: ($size_gb >= 4 AND $size_gb <= 8)  -- 6GB ± 2GB = HIHO range\n};\n```\n\n## EXAMPLES\n\n### Example 1: Healthy Repository\n```bash\n$ du -sh .git\n5.9G    .git\n\n$ git count-objects -vH\ncount: 234\nsize: 1.23 MiB\nin-pack: 234567\npacks: 1\nprune-packable: 0\n\n# ✅ Status: HEALTHY - within target range\n```\n\n### Example 2: Warning State\n```bash\n$ du -sh .git\n7.2G    .git\n\n$ git rev-list --objects --all | grep \"\\.pt$\" | wc -l\n34\n\n# ⚠️  Status: WARNING - approaching limit\n# Action: Run git gc, review large files for git-lfs\n```\n\n### Example 3: Critical State\n```bash\n$ du -sh .git\n13G     .git\n\n$ git count-objects -vH\nsize-pack: 12.8 GiB\n\n# ❌ Status: CRITICAL - exceeds limit\n# Action: Immediate remediation required\n#   1. Create backup tag\n#   2. Run aggressive gc\n#   3. If still >10GB, use filter-repo\n```\n\n## ERROR HANDLING\n\n### Hook Installation Failures\n```bash\n# Symptom: pre-commit install fails\n# Solution: Check Python environment\nuv run pre-commit install\n\n# Verify hooks\nls -la .git/hooks/pre-commit\n```\n\n### CI/CD Workflow Not Running\n```bash\n# Symptom: repo-health.yml not executing\n# Solution: Check workflow permissions\n# GitHub Settings → Actions → Workflow permissions → Read and write\n```\n\n### Git GC Hangs/Stalls\n```bash\n# Symptom: git gc --aggressive runs >4 hours\n# Solution: Kill process, use faster method\nkill <pid>\ngit repack -Ad\ngit prune\n```\n\n### Filter-Repo Corrupts Repository\n```bash\n# Symptom: After filter-repo, repository is unreadable\n# Solution: Restore from backup\ngit clone ../cohezion-backup.git cohezion-restored\ncd cohezion-restored\ngit remote add origin <url>\n```\n\n## VERSION\nv1.0\n\n## EVOLUTION HISTORY\n- **2026-02-12 v1.0**: Initial creation from Task #7 Session 55 governance system\n  - 3-layer governance pattern (Prevention/Detection/Remediation)\n  - Size thresholds: <6GB target, <10GB limit\n  - Pre-commit hooks for files >1MB\n  - CI/CD monitoring via GitHub Actions\n  - Cleanup procedures (gc, filter-repo, lfs)\n  - Charter alignment via HIHO stability metrics\n\n## SEE ALSO\n- GIT_HYGIENE_PRIME (general git best practices)\n- PRE_COMMIT_HOOKS_PRIME (hook configuration patterns)\n- CICD_MONITORING_PRIME (CI/CD workflow patterns)\n- GIT_LFS_MIGRATION_PRIME (large file migration procedures)\n- CHARTER_COMPLIANCE_PRIME (HIHO stability measurement)\n"
